```python
_V1010_RENAMED = {("Train_In", "C34:E34"): "（停用）C34:E34", ("Har_In", "C12:G12"): "C12:D12"}     # v10.1 4-1：Gov_Map 重複登錄整理後的登錄範圍


def _gm_row(ws, sheet, cell):
    rows = [r for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if (ws[f"C{r}"].value, ws[f"D{r}"].value) == (sheet, cell)]
    if not rows and (sheet, cell) in _V1010_RENAMED:
        rows = [r for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if (ws[f"C{r}"].value, ws[f"D{r}"].value) == (sheet, _V1010_RENAMED[(sheet, cell)])]
    assert len(rows) == 1, (sheet, cell, rows)
    return rows[0]


def gov_update(ws, append_text):
    n = 0
    r = _gm_row(ws, "Alloc_In", "C23"); assert ws[f"A{r}"].value == "GM596", ws[f"A{r}"].value
    if ws[f"M{r}"].value == GM_SPEND_RTEXT_OLD: ws[f"M{r}"].value = GM_SPEND_RTEXT; n += 1
    if ws[f"E{r}"].value == LAB_SPEND_OLD: ws[f"E{r}"].value = LAB_SPEND; n += 1
    n += append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], GM_SPEND_TAIL)
    r = _gm_row(ws, "Alloc_In", "D23:E23"); assert ws[f"A{r}"].value == "GM597", ws[f"A{r}"].value
    if ws[f"E{r}"].value == LAB_SPEND_OLD: ws[f"E{r}"].value = LAB_SPEND; n += 1
    n += append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], GM_SPEND_TAIL)
    return n


def gov_map_rows(wb):
    if not ROWS: return []
    out = []
    ai = wb["Alloc_In"]; cap = wb["Cap_In"]
    rk = v529._row_by_label(ai, LAB_KAPPA)
    sc = "切片三（v5.36 κ）"
    reason = (f"v5.36 B4（X47）：請求形狀修正 κ Derived 1.0（0.65–1.2）；依 Sens_Perf 第 93、94 列校準 prefill／decode 成本代入實際輸入輸出比與快取命中，GW 加權 1.035；"
              f"驗證：同公式算 ISL 4K 得 0.4336＝1 ÷ L1_GapISL(v5.35)；乘入 Cap_In 第 109、218 列的有效服務 GW（κ＝1 時數值不變），L1_GapISL＝1 ÷ κ（{EV['N13']}）")
    out.append({'scope': sc, 'sheet': 'Alloc_In', 'cell': f'C{rk}', 'label': LAB_KAPPA, 'check': LAB_KAPPA, 'cls': 'Derived', 'role': '基準', 'src': '', 'rel': '',
                'dec': 'X47', 'lo': f'=Alloc_In!D{rk}', 'hi': f'=Alloc_In!E{rk}', 'rtext': '0.65–1.2（v5.36A 第 3.2 節：API χ 0.9 為 1.17、DeepSeek 型推理 0.66）', 'reason': reason, 'retag': '', 'seg': '中'})
    out.append({'scope': sc, 'sheet': 'Alloc_In', 'cell': f'D{rk}:E{rk}', 'label': LAB_KAPPA, 'check': LAB_KAPPA, 'cls': 'Derived', 'role': '低／高', 'src': '', 'rel': '',
                'dec': 'X47', 'lo': None, 'hi': None, 'rtext': f'C{rk} 的低、高端點', 'reason': reason, 'retag': '', 'seg': '—'})
    sc = "切片三（v5.36 價格時間錯配）"
    for key, nm_, mo in (("j_p4o", "GPT-4o", "7 月（2025-01～07）"), ("j_p5", "GPT-5", "4 月（2025-08～11）"), ("j_p52", "GPT-5.2", "1 月（2025-12）")):
        r = ROWS[key]; lab = cap[f"A{r}"].value
        rs = (f"v5.36 B6（X47）：{nm_} 參考請求（16K 入／2K 出／χ 0.55）未折扣單價（Derived，牌價等級 3，待一手確認；快取價為假設）與 2025 年在線月數 {mo}；"
              f"只進 Cap_In J 節 ρ 與 L1_PriceRho，顯示用，不進任何計算（{EV['N14']}、{EV['N15']}）")
        out.append({'scope': sc, 'sheet': 'Cap_In', 'cell': f'C{r}', 'label': lab, 'check': lab, 'cls': 'Derived', 'role': '單值', 'src': '', 'rel': '', 'dec': 'X47',
                    'lo': cap[f'C{r}'].value, 'hi': cap[f'C{r}'].value, 'rtext': '單值（牌價序列，等級 3；ρ 區間由三者最低／最高決定）', 'reason': rs, 'retag': '', 'seg': '無'})
        out.append({'scope': sc, 'sheet': 'Cap_In', 'cell': f'D{r}', 'label': lab, 'check': lab, 'cls': 'Derived', 'role': '單值', 'src': '', 'rel': '', 'dec': 'X47',
                    'lo': cap[f'D{r}'].value, 'hi': cap[f'D{r}'].value, 'rtext': f'單值（{mo}）', 'reason': rs, 'retag': '', 'seg': '無'})
    return out
```

```python
# v6.0 (work order docs/workorders/20261015_稽核修正1.md r0): downstream-contract definitions (major version; governance plan §8).
#   D7  `_Prod` is the capacity re-solved at the production derate (Theory_Rev_Prod／Fleet_1GW_Prod), not _Util x CTL_ProdDerate; `_Life` has one
#       definition (IFW_*_Life) and IF_*_Life becomes a transitional alias; the m floor / frontier-price rows use the re-solved paid-capacity ratio.
#   D8  "SLO 不可達" is text, never 0 (Perf decode rows, Unit_Cost, Theory_Rev, Training, Perf_Batch consumers); an unreachable tier is excluded and the remaining
#       mix weights are renormalised (Fleet_1GW section D); all tiers unreachable -> text.
#   D11 the pay-back premium (IF_AmortBU_*, hence IF_FullCost_*, IF_FullCostDefault_*) divides by paid tokens only.
# Decisions AF1-D7／AF1-D8／AF1-D11 (IDs D7／D8／D11 already exist in Decisions from Block 1) are appended only through gov.py (DECISIONS_V600); no input cell is changed.
import re
from copy import copy
from openpyxl.utils import get_column_letter as L
from openpyxl.workbook.defined_name import DefinedName
from common import put, F_BOLD, F_NOTE, F_CALC, F_LINK, FILL_KEY, section
import v519
import v530
import v536

VERSION = "20261015_Tokenomics_v6.0"      # single source of the version string: README!B5 and README!A1 (finish.readme)
DATE = "2026-10-15"
V = "v6.0"
WO = "工作單 docs/workorders/20261015_稽核修正1.md r0"
DEC = "docs/reports/20261015_稽核判斷會議_決定.md"
ANDY = "Andy 2026-10-15 稽核判斷會議逐題決定（" + DEC + "）"
SLO = "SLO 不可達"
COLS = range(3, 18)
TIERS = ["Luna", "Sol", "Astra"]
NOTE_ALIAS = "過渡別名＝IFW_{}_Life；下一個主版刪除"


# ================================================================== D7-1／D7-2: _Prod layer rows of Interface J (re-solved SLO source)
def prod_override(wb, F):
    """name -> (formula builder, note) for IFW_TokGW_*_Prod and IFW_RevGWFront*_Prod. Rows come from the v519 targets (Theory_Rev revenue rows 11／29／47)."""
    ws = wb["Theory_Rev"]
    tok_row = {}
    for t, (trow, base) in enumerate(v519.TARGETS[3:6]):
        assert base == f"IF_RevGW_{TIERS[t]}", base
        assert str(ws.cell(trow - 1, 1).value).startswith("每 GW 產出"), (trow - 1, ws.cell(trow - 1, 1).value)
        tok_row[t] = trow - 1
    ov = {}
    for t, tk in enumerate(TIERS):
        tr = tok_row[t]
        ov[f"IFW_TokGW_{tk}_Prod"] = (lambda X, tr=tr: f"=Theory_Rev_Prod!{X}{tr}",
                                      f"（＝Theory_Rev_Prod 第 {tr} 列：生產折減 CTL_ProdDerate 下重解 SLO 後的產出 × IF_Util，與營收 _Prod 同源；v6.0 D7-1）")
        ov[f"IFW_RevGWFront_{tk}_Prod"] = (
            lambda X, tr=tr, t=t: f"=IF(ISNUMBER(Theory_Rev_Prod!{X}{tr}),Theory_Rev_Prod!{X}{tr}*INDEX(B4_FrontRef,1,{t+1})/1E9,Theory_Rev_Prod!{X}{tr})",
            f"（＝Theory_Rev_Prod 第 {tr} 列重解後產出 × 前緣單價；v6.0 D7-2）")
    pay = lambda X: "+".join(f"IF(ISNUMBER(Fleet_1GW_Prod!{X}{F[f'p{t}']}),Fleet_1GW_Prod!{X}{F[f'p{t}']}*INDEX(B4_FrontRef,1,{t+1}),0)" for t in range(3))
    ov["IFW_RevGWFleetFront_Prod"] = (lambda X: f'=IF(Fleet_1GW_Prod!{X}{F["ok"]}=1,({pay(X)})/1E9,"{SLO}")',
                                      "（＝Fleet_1GW_Prod 付費 token（重解後）× 前緣單價；v6.0 D7-2）")
    return ov


def patch_j_header(wb, IFJ):
    ws = wb["Interface"]
    cell = ws.cell(IFJ["start"], 1)
    old = "營收 _Prod 讀 G 節（重解 SLO 後的值）、token 產能 _Prod 為線性乘法"
    assert old in cell.value
    cell.value = cell.value.replace(old, "_Prod 一律為重解 SLO 後的值（營收讀 G 節；token 產能與前緣營收讀 Theory_Rev_Prod／Fleet_1GW_Prod；v6.0 D7-1／D7-2）") \
        .replace("H 節 _Life（不含折減", "H 節 IF_*_Life 為本節 IFW_*_Life 的過渡別名（下一個主版刪除）；原 H 節 _Life（不含折減")


# ================================================================== D7-3: IF_*_Life becomes an alias of IFW_*_Life
def life_alias(wb, IFJ):
    import v522
    tr = wb["Theory_Rev"]; itf = wb["Interface"]
    for trow, base in v522.TARGETS:
        rr = v522.TR_ROWS[base]; stem = base[3:]
        for k, c in enumerate(COLS, start=1):
            tr.cell(rr, c).value = f"=INDEX(IFW_{stem}_Life,1,{k})"
        lab = tr.cell(rr, 1).value
        tr.cell(rr, 1).value = lab.replace("（× 壽命期價格係數 L × 變現率 m）", "（過渡別名＝IFW_%s_Life；下一個主版刪除）" % stem)
        brow = int(re.match(r"Interface!\$C\$(\d+):", wb.defined_names[base + "_Life"].attr_text).group(1))
        a = itf.cell(brow, 1).value
        assert "（× L × m）" in a, a
        itf.cell(brow, 1).value = a.replace("（× L × m）", "（× L × m；" + NOTE_ALIAS.format(stem) + "）")
        # self-check rows: Interface alias vs IFW (identity)
        fr = v522.TR_FLAGS[base]
        tr.cell(fr, 1).value = f"{base}_Life：Interface 別名 vs IFW_{stem}_Life（應相同）"
        for k, c in enumerate(COLS, start=1):
            a_, b_ = f"INDEX({base}_Life,1,{k})", f"INDEX(IFW_{stem}_Life,1,{k})"
            tr.cell(fr, c).value = (f"=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({a_}),ISNUMBER({b_})),IF(ABS({a_}-{b_})<=0.000000001,0,1),"
                                    f"IF(AND(NOT(ISNUMBER({a_})),NOT(ISNUMBER({b_}))),IF({a_}={b_},0,1),1))")
    tr.cell(v522.TR_START + 6, 1).value = ("自我檢查（Checks Y／X7；v6.0 D7-3 起）：Interface 的 IF_*_Life 別名列 − 對應 IFW_*_Life 的絕對差 ≤ 1e-9（兩邊皆為文字時須文字相同）；0＝相符，1＝不符")
    tr.cell(v522.TR_START, 1).value = ("D. 營收實現（X7，v5.22；v6.0 D7-3 起為 IFW_*_Life 的過渡別名，下一個主版刪除）：IFW_*_Life＝重解 SLO 的 _Prod 列 × 壽命期價格係數 L（CTL_PriceLife）× 變現率 m（CTL_Monetize）；"
                                       "基準列為文字（SLO 不可達）時輸出相同文字")
    for r in range(1, itf.max_row + 1):
        v = itf.cell(r, 1).value
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("H. 營收實現並列輸出"):
            itf.cell(r, 1).value = v.replace("H. 營收實現並列輸出（X7，v5.22）", "H. 營收實現並列輸出（X7，v5.22；v6.0 D7-3 起 IF_*_Life＝IFW_*_Life 的過渡別名，下一個主版刪除）")
            break
    ck = wb["Checks"]
    for r in range(1, ck.max_row + 1):
        if ck.cell(r, 1).value == "X7":
            ck.cell(r, 2).value = "營收實現別名：Interface 的 IF_*_Life 不等於對應 IFW_*_Life 的格數（絕對差 > 1e-9；文字列須相同；v6.0 D7-3）"


# ================================================================== D7-1: _Prod identity (Checks Z1)
def prod_identity(wb, IFJ):
    """Theory_Rev rows 101+: _Prod revenue ÷ _Prod token = tier price (OpenAI and Front), 1e-9 relative. Returns (first, last)."""
    tr = wb["Theory_Rev"]
    r0 = tr.max_row + 2
    section(tr, r0, "E. _Prod 恆等式自我檢查（v6.0 D7-1；Checks Z1）：IFW_RevGW*_Prod × 1E9 ÷ IFW_TokGW_*_Prod ＝ 該層級單價（B4_EffRef／B4_FrontRef），相對差 ≤ 1e-9；"
                      "兩邊皆為文字須相同；0＝相符，1＝不符", 17)
    r = r0 + 1; first = r
    for kind, rev, ref in (("OpenAI 有效單價", "IFW_RevGW_{}_Prod", "B4_EffRef"), ("前緣單價", "IFW_RevGWFront_{}_Prod", "B4_FrontRef")):
        for t, tk in enumerate(TIERS):
            put(tr, f"A{r}", f"{tk}｜{kind}：_Prod 營收 ÷ _Prod token vs {ref}", F_NOTE)
            for k, c in enumerate(COLS, start=1):
                rv, tok, px = f"INDEX({rev.format(tk)},1,{k})", f"INDEX(IFW_TokGW_{tk}_Prod,1,{k})", f"INDEX({ref},1,{t+1})"
                put(tr, f"{L(c)}{r}",
                    f"=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({rv}),ISNUMBER({tok})),IF({tok}>0,IF(ABS({rv}*1E9/{tok}-{px})<=0.000000001*{px},0,1),1),"
                    f"IF(AND(NOT(ISNUMBER({rv})),NOT(ISNUMBER({tok}))),IF({rv}={tok},0,1),1))", fmt="0")
            r += 1
    return first, r - 1


def checks_z(wb, rows):
    ws = wb["Checks"]
    r = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, r, "Z. 契約定義檢查（工作單 稽核修正1，v6.0）：Z1 為 ERROR 計入 GOV_Errors", 6); r += 1
    for i, h in enumerate(["編號", "檢查", "等級", "筆數", "範圍與算法"]): put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}{r}", h, F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    first, last = rows
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "Z1"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "_Prod 恆等式：同一層級 _Prod 營收 ÷ _Prod token 不等於該層級單價（OpenAI 有效單價與前緣單價）的格數（相對差 > 1e-9；v6.0 D7-1）"); put(ws, f"C{r}", "ERROR", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"D{r}", f"=SUM(Theory_Rev!C{first}:Q{last})", fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"E{r}", f"Theory_Rev 第 {first}–{last} 列 × C:Q（6 × 15＝90 格）", F_NOTE)
    ref = wb.defined_names["GOV_Errors"].attr_text.split("!")[1].replace("$", "")
    cell = ws[ref]
    if f"D{r}" not in str(cell.value): cell.value = f"{cell.value}+D{r}"
    ws[f"B{int(ref[1:])}"].value = "ERROR 合計（CI 讀取 GOV_Errors；含 G、H、X、Y、Z 節）"
    return r


# ================================================================== D7-2: paid-capacity ratio at the production derate (Alloc H section)
def alloc_prod_ratio(wb, R, F):
    """Appends Alloc section H: per-generation paid capacity re-solved at CTL_ProdDerate (Fleet_1GW_Prod ÷ Fleet_1GW paid tokens x AL_CapPaid), the generation blend
    and the ratio AL_ProdRatioPaid. Nothing above moves."""
    ws = wb["Alloc"]
    r = ws.max_row + 2
    section(ws, r, "H. 生產折減下的付費產能比（v6.0 D7-2；欄 C–F＝服務世代 Hopper／GB200／GB300／VR200）：以 CTL_ProdDerate 重解 SLO 後的付費產能 ÷ 基準；取代線性的 CTL_ProdDerate", 7); r += 1
    col = lambda c: f"{c}${R['col']}"
    tp_b = lambda c: f"INDEX(Fleet_1GW!$C${F['Tp']}:$Q${F['Tp']},1,{col(c)})"
    tp_p = lambda c: f"INDEX(Fleet_1GW_Prod!$C${F['Tp']}:$Q${F['Tp']},1,{col(c)})"
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "各世代每 GW 年付費產能（生產折減；重解 SLO）＝基準產能 × Fleet_1GW_Prod ÷ Fleet_1GW 的付費 token 總量", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "M tok/GW/年")
    for c in "CDEF":
        put(ws, f"{c}{r}", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({c}{R["capp"]}),ISNUMBER({tp_b(c)}),ISNUMBER({tp_p(c)})),{c}{R["capp"]}*{tp_p(c)}/{tp_b(c)},"{SLO}")', fmt="#,##0")
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "付費 token 總量同式於 Fleet_1GW 第 %d 列（兩邊 GW 配置相同，比值即每 GW 產能比）" % F["Tp"], F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["AL_CapPaidProd"] = DefinedName("AL_CapPaidProd", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}:$F${r}")
    cap = r; r += 1
    ss = [f"{c}${R['share']}" for c in "CDEF"]; cc = [f"{c}${cap}" for c in "CDEF"]
    # v6.2 2-1-c: a generation whose re-solved capacity is text (no reachable tier) drops out and the mix is renormalised over the rest (same rule as Alloc section B)
    den = "(" + "+".join(f"IF(AND({s}>0,ISNUMBER({k})),{s},0)" for s, k in zip(ss, cc)) + ")"
    num = "+".join(f"IF(AND({s}>0,ISNUMBER({k})),{s}*{k},0)" for s, k in zip(ss, cc))
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "世代組合後每 GW 年付費產能（生產折減）＝Σ 世代占比 × 各世代產能（只含可服務世代，占比重新正規化）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "M tok/GW/年")
    unserved = "OR(" + ",".join(f"AND({s}>0,NOT(ISNUMBER({k})))" for s, k in zip(ss, cc)) + ")"      # v6.3 K2: a generation that is entirely unreachable is not dropped (no transfer of its share)
    put(ws, f"C{r}", f'=IF({unserved},"整代不可達",IF({den}>0,({num})/{den},"{SLO}"))', fmt="#,##0")
    wb.defined_names["AL_BlendPaidProd"] = DefinedName("AL_BlendPaidProd", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}"); r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "付費產能比（生產折減重解 ÷ 基準）　→ Cap_In 第 115 列「利用率修正（上限）」", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "x")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_BlendPaidProd),ISNUMBER(AL_BlendPaid)),IF(AL_BlendPaid>0,AL_BlendPaidProd/AL_BlendPaid,"{SLO}"),"{SLO}")', fmt="0.0000", fill=FILL_KEY)
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "2025 世代組合下約 0.712（線性 CTL_ProdDerate 為 0.85）；m 下限 ∝ 1 ÷ 此比", F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["AL_ProdRatioPaid"] = DefinedName("AL_ProdRatioPaid", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}")
    R["prodratio"] = r
    return r
```

```python
def patch_specs():

# ================================================================== guarded value writes (Excel-owned cells)
def _chk(ws, addr, label):
    assert ws[f"A{addr[1:]}"].value == label, (ws.title, addr, ws[f"A{addr[1:]}"].value, label)


def inputs_update(wb):
    """Each value is written only while the cell still holds its v6.0 value (gov.gm_update rule)."""
    log = []

    def setv(sh, addr, old, new, tag):
```

```python
# v6.3 (work order docs/workorders/20261016_稽核修正2.md r1, section 2b = segment 2-1b): scale-basis repairs after 2-1 and 2Q (minor version).
#   K1 the mixed unit price paired with the Alloc generation-mixed (fleet) tokens uses the same reachable tiers as the capacity side: tier weights are renormalised over the
#      reachable tiers per generation (Alloc section I: AL_PriceGen, AL_PriceFleet), then weighted across generations by paid-token share (share x AL_CapPaid) so that
#      revenue / (fleet tokens x price) uses ONE set of tiers. Cap_In H7 (m_fleet, m floor, "must be true" rows), H10 m_fleet (Cap_In K section: B4_PriceFleet), L1_PriceRealFleet and
#      L1_PriceReqBE read it. Demand-route prices (model tokens AL_DPaid, row 90) keep the full tier mix B4_MixPaid.
#   K2 the generation mix is an observed fleet fact: a generation with share > 0 whose tiers are all unreachable is not dropped and its share is not transferred; AL_BlendPaid／Free,
#      AL_ServeGW, AL_Q1／Q2 and the closure names answer the text flag "整代不可達" (block6.py, v600.py, v534._CAP). AL_UnservedGen stays.
#   K3 Perf／Perf_Batch／Sens_Perf row "decode GPU-s per M" (and the _Prod mirrors) answers "TTFT 不可達" when row 77 (TTFT) is "否" (perf.py).
#   K4 investigation only (report); nothing is changed for it.

# ================================================================== spec patches (before the specs are written; call right after v601.patch_specs())
def patch_specs():
    global _PATCHED
    if _PATCHED: return
    # ---- K1: Cap_In H7 rows that pair the price with fleet tokens read AL_PriceFleet (Alloc section I) ----
    tag = "機隊口徑混合有效單價（AL_PriceFleet：可達層級重新正規化；v6.3 K1）"
    sp = v533.SPEC
    for key in ("m_fleet", "m_fleet_rs", "m_floor", "need_1", "need_06", "need_03"):
        i = next(i for i, it in enumerate(sp) if it[0] == key)
        it = list(sp[i])
        for k in range(3, 6):
            if isinstance(it[k], str):
                for X in "CDE": it[k] = it[k].replace(f"{X}{{P_price}}", "AL_PriceFleet")
        if key.startswith("need"):       # AL_PriceFleet may be the text 整代不可達 (K2): text passes through, never #VALUE!
            it[3] = f'=IF(ISNUMBER(AL_PriceFleet),{it[3][1:]},AL_PriceFleet)'
            it[4] = f'=IF(ISNUMBER(C{{{key}}}),C{{{key}}}/AL_DPaid,C{{{key}}})'
            it[5] = it[5].replace("ISNUMBER(C{tok_ceil})", f"AND(ISNUMBER(C{{tok_ceil}}),ISNUMBER(C{{{key}}}))", 1)
        it[1] = it[1].replace("混合有效單價", tag).replace("單價", "機隊口徑單價（AL_PriceFleet）") if key.startswith("need") else it[1].replace("混合有效單價", tag)
        assert "P_price" not in "".join(str(x) for x in it[3:6]), key
        sp[i] = tuple(it)
    # ---- K1: Cap_In H10 m_fleet reads the Cap_In K-section row (named B4_PriceFleet, 1x4 C:F) ----
    sp = v534.SPEC_H10
    j = next(i for i, it in enumerate(sp) if it[0] == "q_m_fleet")
    it = list(sp[j])
    for k, X in zip(range(3, 7), "CDEF"):
        assert f"{X}{{q_price}}" in it[k], it[k]
        it[k] = it[k].replace(f"{X}{{q_price}}", f"INDEX(B4_PriceFleet,1,{'CDEF'.index(X) + 1})")
    it[1] = "m_fleet＝m 分子營收 ÷（機隊付費 token × 機隊口徑單價 B4_PriceFleet；Cap_In K 節；v6.3 K1）"
    sp[j] = tuple(it)
    _PATCHED = True


# ================================================================== K1: Alloc section I (appended after H; nothing above moves)
def alloc_fleet_price(wb, R):
    ws = wb["Alloc"]
    r = ws.max_row + 2
    section(ws, r, "I. 機隊口徑混合有效單價（v6.3 K1；欄 C–F＝服務世代 Hopper／GB200／GB300／VR200）：與機隊付費 token 配對的單價，層級權重只在可達層級間重新正規化（同 B 節），"
                   "世代間以付費 token 占比（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能）加權", 7); r += 1
    price = {"Luna": "IF_PriceRef_Luna", "Sol": "IF_PriceRef_Sol", "Astra": "IF_PriceRef_Astra"}
    flags = lambda c: [f"{c}{R[k]}" for k in ("rl", "rs", "ra")]
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "各世代付費 token 混合有效單價＝Σ（可達層級的付費組合權重 × 該層級參考單價）÷ 可達層級權重合計（全不可達的世代為文字）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$/M")
    for c in "CDEF":
        num = "+".join(f"IF({f}=1,INDEX(B4_MixPaid,1,{t})*{price[tn]},0)" for t, (f, (tn, _)) in enumerate(zip(flags(c), TIERS), 1))
        put(ws, f"{c}{r}", f'=IF({c}{R["ok"]}=1,({num})/{c}{R["wp"]},"{SLO}")', fmt="0.0000")
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "全層級可達時等於 Cap_In 第 90 列（B4_MixPaid × IF_PriceRef_*）；v8.0 以前基準下 Hopper 欄排除 Astra（TTFT 不可達）；v9.0 起快取命中進 prefill 產能，基準下全層級可達，等於第 90 列（κ＝1）", F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["AL_PriceGen"] = DefinedName("AL_PriceGen", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}:$F${r}")
    pg = r; r += 1
    ss = [f"{c}${R['share']}" for c in "CDEF"]; ok = [f"{c}${R['ok']}" for c in "CDEF"]
    cp = [f"{c}${R['capp']}" for c in "CDEF"]; pgc = [f"{c}${pg}" for c in "CDEF"]
    num = "+".join(f"IF(AND({s}>0,{o}=1),{s}*{k}*{p},0)" for s, o, k, p in zip(ss, ok, cp, pgc))
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊口徑混合有效單價＝Σ（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能 × 各世代單價）÷ Σ（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能）＝ 機隊付費 token 的平均單價", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$/M")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", f'=IF(AL_BlendPaid="{GENX}","{GENX}",IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_BlendPaid),AL_GenShareOK>0),IF(AL_BlendPaid>0,({num})/AL_GenShareOK/AL_BlendPaid,"{SLO}"),"{SLO}"))',
        fmt="0.0000", fill=FILL_KEY)
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "分子分母同為可達層級、可服務世代；與 Cap_In H7 的機隊付費 token（AL_BlendPaid 加權）同口徑。全層級可達時等於 Cap_In 第 90 列", F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["AL_PriceFleet"] = DefinedName("AL_PriceFleet", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}")
    pf = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "對照：完整層級組合混合有效單價（Cap_In 第 90 列；需求路線的模型 token 用此價）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$/M")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", "=Cap_In!$C$90", fmt="0.0000")
    pc = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊口徑單價 ÷ 完整層級組合單價（<1：被排除的層級單價較高）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "x")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", f'=IF(ISNUMBER(C{pf}),C{pf}/C{pc},C{pf})', fmt="0.0000")
    r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "不可用文字（K2）：服務 GW 因整代不可達而為文字時＝「整代不可達」，否則「SLO 不可達」；Cap_In／L1 的機隊閉合名稱以它取代寫死的「SLO 不可達」，使旗標一路傳到下游", wrap=True)
    put(ws, f"C{r}", f'=IF(AL_ServeGW="{GENX}","{GENX}","{SLO}")')
    wb.defined_names["AL_UnavailTxt"] = DefinedName("AL_UnavailTxt", attr_text=f"Alloc!$C${r}")
    R["pf"] = pf
    R["pg"] = pg
    return r


def unavail_text(wb):
    """K2: in Cap_In H7 onward (rows >= 113) and the L1 sheet, the hard-coded fallback text "SLO 不可達" becomes AL_UnavailTxt, which reads
    "整代不可達" exactly when AL_ServeGW is that text (else "SLO 不可達", so the base and every other scenario are unchanged)."""
    lit = f'"{SLO}"'
    n = 0
    for sh, r_min in (("Cap_In", 113), ("L1", 1)):
        ws = wb[sh]
        for row in ws.iter_rows(min_row=r_min):
            for c in row:
                v = c.value
                if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=") and lit in v and "AL_UnavailTxt" not in v:
                    c.value = v.replace(lit, "AL_UnavailTxt"); n += 1
    return [f"v603 K2: {n} Cap_In／L1 fallback texts now read AL_UnavailTxt"]


# ================================================================== K1: Cap_In K section (below the reading row; no row above moves)
def cap_in_k(wb, h36):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    r0 = h36["end"] + 2
    assert ws.max_row == h36["end"], (ws.max_row, h36["end"])
    put(ws, f"A{r0}", "K. 機隊口徑單價（v6.3 K1）：H10 m_fleet 的單價。欄位同 H10：C＝2025 年度（Alloc 的 AL_PriceFleet）、D／E／F＝2026 各欄以該欄的世代組合（H10-4 第 {q_mix_h}–{q_mix_vr} 列）重算；"
                          "公式同 Alloc I 節：Σ（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能 × 各世代單價）÷ Σ（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能），只含可服務世代；H7 讀 AL_PriceFleet"
        .format(q_mix_h=v534.ROWS["q_mix_h"], q_mix_vr=v534.ROWS["q_mix_vr"]), F_BOLD)
    r = r0 + 1
    mixrows = [v534.ROWS[k] for k in ("q_mix_h", "q_mix_gb200", "q_mix_gb300", "q_mix_vr")]
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊口徑混合有效單價（付費 token；可達層級重新正規化）　→ H10 m_fleet", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$/M")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", "=AL_PriceFleet", F_CALC, fmt="0.0000", fill=FILL_KEY)
    for col in "DEF":
        s = [f"{col}{m}" for m in mixrows]
        cp = [f"INDEX(AL_CapPaid,1,{i})" for i in (1, 2, 3, 4)]; pg = [f"INDEX(AL_PriceGen,1,{i})" for i in (1, 2, 3, 4)]
        un = "OR(" + ",".join(f"AND({a}>0,NOT(ISNUMBER({b})))" for a, b in zip(s, cp)) + ")"
        num = "+".join(f"IF(AND({a}>0,ISNUMBER({b})),{a}*{b}*{p},0)" for a, b, p in zip(s, cp, pg))
        den = "+".join(f"IF(AND({a}>0,ISNUMBER({b})),{a}*{b},0)" for a, b in zip(s, cp))
        put(ws, f"{col}{r}", f'=IF({un},"{GENX}",IF(({den})>0,({num})/({den}),"{SLO}"))', F_CALC, fmt="0.0000")
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "Derived｜2026 欄的世代單價與付費產能為基準情境（AL_PriceGen、AL_CapPaid），只有世代組合不同", F_NOTE)
    wb.defined_names["B4_PriceFleet"] = DefinedName("B4_PriceFleet", attr_text=f"Cap_In!$C${r}:$F${r}")
    kr = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "對照：完整層級組合混合有效單價（第 90 列；需求路線的模型 token 用此價）", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$/M")
    for col in "CDEF": put(ws, f"{col}{r}", "=$C$90", F_CALC, fmt="0.0000")
    kc = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊口徑單價 ÷ 完整層級組合單價", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "x")
    for col in "CDEF": put(ws, f"{col}{r}", f"=IF(ISNUMBER({col}{kr}),{col}{kr}/{col}{kc},{col}{kr})", F_CALC, fmt="0.0000")
    return dict(start=r0, end=r, price_row=kr)

OLD_LOHI = {"lo": [0.1, 0.3, 1, 1, 1], "hi": [0.5, 1.0, 1, 4.4, 1]}
NEW_LOHI = {"lo": [0.5, 0.3, 1, 1, 1], "hi": [1.3, 1.0, 1, 2.5, 1]}
NOTE_LO_OLD_HEAD = "Assumed｜區間低端（相對 2026 Arch 快照的啟用參數倍數）：Hopper 數百億 ÷ 180B ≈ 0.1；GB200 0.3；GB300 與 VR200 為 1（J1）"
NOTE_LO_NEW = ("Assumed（Hopper、GB200 為 Analogy）｜區間低端（相對 2026 Arch 快照的啟用參數倍數）：Hopper 0.5、GB200 0.3、GB300 1、VR200 1、Rubin Ultra 固定 1。"
               "r1（2Q 報告 Q2）：Hopper 代表模型 GPT-4 級啟用參數約 220–280B，大於快照 Astra 的 180B，r0 的 0.1 方向錯誤，改 0.5")
NOTE_HI_OLD_HEAD = "Assumed｜區間高端：Hopper 0.5；GB200 1.0；GB300 1；VR200 400–800B ÷ 180B ≈ 4.4（J1）；R-b 讀法（快照對應 GB200）由 Project 另發 r1"
NOTE_HI_NEW = ("Assumed（Hopper、GB200 為 Analogy）｜區間高端：Hopper 1.3、GB200 1.0、GB300 1、VR200 2.5、Rubin Ultra 固定 1。"
               "r1（2Q 報告 Q2）：Hopper 1.3、VR200 2.5（r0 的 4.4 無證據）；情境 d1_model_scale 取 Hopper 0.8／GB200 0.55／GB300 1／VR200 1.4。暫不分層級（留待 Andy 決定）")


def inputs_update(wb):
    ws = wb["Spec_Rack"]; log = []
    r0 = next(r for r in range(20, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 1).value == v602.SEC_TITLE)
    for off, key, nm in ((2, "lo", "ARCH_ScaleGen_Lo"), (3, "hi", "ARCH_ScaleGen_Hi")):
        r = r0 + off
        assert ws.cell(r, 1).value.endswith(f"（{nm}）"), ws.cell(r, 1).value
        for col, old, new in zip("CDEFG", OLD_LOHI[key], NEW_LOHI[key]):
            c = ws[f"{col}{r}"]
            if c.value is not None and type(c.value) is not bool and c.value == old and old != new:
                c.value = new; log.append(f"Spec_Rack!{col}{r}: {old} -> {new} ({nm}, v6.3 J1 r1)")
        h = ws[f"H{r}"]
        old_h, new_h = (NOTE_LO_OLD_HEAD, NOTE_LO_NEW) if key == "lo" else (NOTE_HI_OLD_HEAD, NOTE_HI_NEW)
        if isinstance(h.value, str) and h.value == old_h:
            h.value = new_h; log.append(f"Spec_Rack!H{r}: note (v6.3 J1 r1)")
    return log


def gov_update(ws, append_text):
    n = 0
    for cell, col, old, new in (
            ("C45:G45", "M", "低端：Hopper 0.1、GB200 0.3、GB300 1、VR200 1", "低端：Hopper 0.5、GB200 0.3、GB300 1、VR200 1（r1，2Q Q2）"),
            ("C46:G46", "M", "高端：Hopper 0.5、GB200 1.0、GB300 1、VR200 4.4", "高端：Hopper 1.3、GB200 1.0、GB300 1、VR200 2.5（r1，2Q Q2）")):
        r = v536._gm_row(ws, "Spec_Rack", cell)
        if ws[f"{col}{r}"].value == old:
            ws[f"{col}{r}"].value = new; n += 1
        n += append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], " ｜v6.3 J1 r1（AF2-D1c，2Q 報告 Q2）：Hopper 0.8（0.5–1.3）、GB200 0.55（0.3–1.0）為 Analogy；VR200 1.4（1.0–2.5）為 Assumed；GB300＝1 為定義；Rubin Ultra 未設定，固定 1")
    r = v536._gm_row(ws, "Spec_Rack", "C44:G44")
    n += append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], " ｜v6.3 J1 r1：情境 d1_model_scale 取 2Q 值 0.8／0.55／1／1.4（基準列仍全 1）")
    return n


def decisions_update(wb):
    ws = wb["Decisions"]; log = []
    for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
        if ws.cell(r, 1).value == "AF2-D1c":
            add = "｜r1（v6.3，2Q 報告 Q2）：依 2Q 修訂。情境 d1_model_scale＝Hopper 0.8／GB200 0.55／GB300 1／VR200 1.4（Rubin Ultra 固定 1）；區間 Lo＝0.5／0.3／1／1、Hi＝1.3／1.0／1／2.5；r0 的 0.25／0.5／1／2.5 方向與證據相反（GPT-4 啟用參數大於 Astra 180B）。暫不分層級。"
            if isinstance(ws.cell(r, 4).value, str) and add not in ws.cell(r, 4).value:
                ws.cell(r, 4).value = ws.cell(r, 4).value + add; log.append("Decisions AF2-D1c: r1 note (v6.3)")
    return log
```

```python
def _thr_expr(kind, g, prev, q, d):
    if kind == "Rev":
        return f"{q}^(-1/{d})-1"
    return f"(L1_HoldEconMW_{g}/L1_HoldEconMW_{prev}/{q})^(1/{d})-1"


def _thr(kind, g, prev, qs, ds):
    """qs／ds: three-name tuples (base, lo, hi). Returns (D, E, F) formulas. E／F are the smaller／larger of the two corner values (q low & Δ low, q high & Δ high), so that
    the L1 column convention E ≤ D ≤ F (Checks H3) holds even where q < 1 flips the order (VR200)."""
    guard = lambda q, d: (f"IF(AND(ISNUMBER({q}),ISNUMBER({d})" + (f",ISNUMBER(L1_HoldEconMW_{g}),ISNUMBER(L1_HoldEconMW_{prev})" if kind == "Pay" else "") + f"),"
                          f"IF(AND({q}>0,{d}>0" + (f",L1_HoldEconMW_{prev}>0" if kind == "Pay" else "") + f"),%s,{UN}),{UN})")
    qb, ql, qh = qs; db, dl, dh = ds
    D = "=" + guard(qb, db) % _thr_expr(kind, g, prev, qb, db)
    c1, c2 = _thr_expr(kind, g, prev, ql, dl), _thr_expr(kind, g, prev, qh, dh)
    ok = f"AND(ISNUMBER({ql}),ISNUMBER({qh}),ISNUMBER({dl}),ISNUMBER({dh})" + (f",ISNUMBER(L1_HoldEconMW_{g}),ISNUMBER(L1_HoldEconMW_{prev})" if kind == "Pay" else "") + ")"
    pos = f"AND({ql}>0,{qh}>0,{dl}>0,{dh}>0" + (f",L1_HoldEconMW_{prev}>0" if kind == "Pay" else "") + ")"
    E = f"=IF({ok},IF({pos},MIN({c1},{c2}),{UN}),{UN})"
    F = f"=IF({ok},IF({pos},MAX({c1},{c2}),{UN}),{UN})"
    return D, E, F

# ================================================================== Gov_Map: new rows for the Cap_In L inputs, updates of existing rows (guarded)
def gov_update(ws, append_text):
    import v536
    n = 0
    r = v536._gm_row(ws, "Calib", "C68"); assert ws[f"A{r}"].value == "GM346", ws[f"A{r}"].value
    if ws[f"F{r}"].value == "Assumed":
        ws[f"F{r}"].value = "倒推"; n += 1
    r = v536._gm_row(ws, "Serving", "C28")
    n += append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], " ｜v7.0 J3（AF2c-J3）：C28 是生產折減的唯一入口；Serving C18 固定 1.0，情境 b_prod_derate 改以 CTL_ProdDerate 驅動")
    for cell in ("C226", "D226:E226"):
        r = v536._gm_row(ws, "Cap_In", cell)
        n += append_text(ws[f"N{r}"], " ｜v7.0 B-0 Q2（AF2c-GEN）：g 的依據是換代價格比較，壽命內衰減與世代間價格變化應分開；世代間以 L1_GenPxThr_* 門檻表達，g 的數值與區間不變")
    return n


def gov_map_rows(wb):
    ws = wb["Cap_In"]
    r0 = next(r for r in range(200, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 1).value == SEC_TITLE)
    out = []
    for i, (g, prev, pair, base, lo, hi, note) in enumerate(GENS):
        r = r0 + 1 + i
        lab = ws.cell(r, 1).value
        reason = (f"世代價格 B 段 B-1（{ANDY_GEN}）：{pair} 世代上市間隔，基準 {base} 年（{lo}–{hi}）；{note}。標記：工作單寫 Analogy（單一樣本）；Gov_Map 類別暫登 Assumed——"
                  f"Gov_Map 的 Analogy 須有可比 SRC_ID（Checks E2），而上市日期尚無 SRC 紀錄（A 段報告第 5 節；列待 Project 判斷）。只進 L1_GenPxThr_Rev_{g}／_Pay_{g}，不進任何 IF_；"
                  f"{WOB} B-1")
        for cell, role, lo_, hi_, rt in ((f"C{r}", "基準", f"=Cap_In!D{r}", f"=Cap_In!E{r}", f"{lo}–{hi} 年（低＝雲端對雲端／首家部署；高＝量產宣布對量產宣布／實例上線）"),
                                         (f"D{r}:E{r}", "低／高", None, None, f"C{r} 的低、高端點")):
            out.append({'scope': '切片三（v7.0 世代價格 B 段）', 'sheet': 'Cap_In', 'cell': cell, 'label': lab, 'check': lab, 'cls': 'Assumed', 'role': role, 'src': '', 'rel': '',
                        'dec': 'AF2c-GEN', 'lo': lo_, 'hi': hi_, 'rtext': rt, 'reason': reason, 'retag': '', 'seg': '中' if role == "基準" else '—'})
    return out
```

```python
#      the 2025 mixed effective price (same writing as Cap_In row 90: paid mix x list price x (1 - B4_Disc)) and the fleet-basis 2025 price (Alloc K section, AL_PriceFleet25: tier weights

#   L2 2025 model scale: baseline keeps the fixed model (R1); scenario d2_model_2025 (ARCH_ScaleGen Hopper／GB200 = 0.65, range 0.35–1.1) is in tests/parity/scenarios.yaml; nothing in the workbook.

#   L4 payback on one generation basis: L1_LReqFleet reads the 2025 fleet breakeven L1_FleetBreakeven2025 (Alloc K: AL_HoldGen weighted by the generation mix over the 2025-price revenue per GW);

#      Checks B43 reads AL_MixHopper (block4.py).

def _px(s):

    return re.sub(r"\bAL_PriceFleet\b", "AL_PriceFleet25", s)


# ================================================================== spec patches (before the specs are written; call right after v603.patch_specs())

    sp = v535.SPEC_I

        if it[0] == "i_req_fleet":

            it[7] = "v8.0 L4：L1_FleetBreakeven2025（Alloc K 節）÷（IF_Util × CTL_ProdDerate × m）；基準值見 L1_LReqFleet；v7.0 的 VR200 口徑（0.530）保留於 M 節對照列"

    for nmx, col in (("CAP_Price25Mix", "C"), ("CAP_Price25Mix_Lo", "D"), ("CAP_Price25Mix_Hi", "E")):

                               "v7.0 的 L1_MFleet 值（0.5565）；D2 之前的混用口徑，只作對照 → L1_MFleet_Px2026"),
                              ("m25lo", "m（2025 單價取低端）＝營收 ÷（機隊付費 token × AL_PriceFleet25_Lo）", "AL_PriceFleet25_Lo", "單價低端使 m 較高；顯示用"),
                              ("m25hi", "m（2025 單價取高端）＝營收 ÷（機隊付費 token × AL_PriceFleet25_Hi）", "AL_PriceFleet25_Hi", "單價高端使 m 較低；顯示用")):

    put(ws, f"A{r}", "回本所需 L（VR200 新建、2026 單價、固定模型；不與 2025 m 比較）＝L1_FleetBreakeven ÷（IF_Util × CTL_ProdDerate × m（2026 牌價對照））　→ L1_LReqFleet_VR200", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "x")
    for col, mc in (("C", "C"), ("D", "E"), ("E", "D")):

    CM["lreq_vr"] = r; r += 1

    for col, gc in (("C", "C"), ("D", "E"), ("E", "D")):

    put(ws, f"F{r}", "Derived"); put(ws, f"G{r}", "不經每 GW 營收與 m 配對：成本（支出路線 GW × 持有成本）÷ 實收營收。與第 240 列（字面口徑）的差距見報告；列待 Project 判斷", F_NOTE)
    CM["lreq_id"] = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "M-4. Astra Epoch 上限的隱含 token（D14）：Epoch 1.0e27 為 GPT-6 Astra 叢集總算力（含後訓練，上限）；全算為預訓練時 token＝FLOP ÷（6 × 啟用參數）。基準 token 60T 與參數 180B 不變；差距分配不在本段決定", F_BOLD); r += 1
    for n, nm_ in ((180, None), (400, 400), (800, 800)):
        put(ws, f"A{r}", LAB_N(n), wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "B 參數")

        CM[f"tok{n}"] = r; r += 1
    CM["start"], CM["end"] = r0, r - 1
    return dict(start=r0, end=r - 1, rows=dict(CM))


# ================================================================== L3: Alloc_In R&D generation mix (appended after the existing content)
def alloc_in_rd_mix(wb):
    import v529
    ws = wb["Alloc_In"]
    r = v529._last_row(ws) + 2
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "v8.0 L3：研發世代組合（2025；Derived；GW 占比，四格合計 100%，Checks Z2）。研發算力用的硬體世代組合，與服務世代組合分開輸入；Train_In 第 16 列（訓練世代 VR200）與 Training 頁不動", F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    out = {}
    note = (f"2Q 報告第 3 節（Derived，低信心）：GPT-5.2（2025-12）在 Hopper 與 GB200 NVL72 上訓練；Stargate Abilene GB200 自 2025-06 交付；VR200 雲端最早 2026-09-30 才供應，所以 2025 年 VR200＝0 是高信心結論，"
            f"其餘三個世代的比例是推導。研發偏新世代，但全年平均只略偏新於服務組合（0.6／0.4／0／0）。低／高為各格的區間端點，不是情境（四格各自取端點時合計不為 100%）")
    for g, base, lo, hi in RDMIX:
        put(ws, f"A{r}", LAB_RDMIX(g), wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "%")
        put(ws, f"C{r}", base, F_IN, fmt="0%", fill=FILL_KEY); put(ws, f"D{r}", lo, F_IN, fmt="0%"); put(ws, f"E{r}", hi, F_IN, fmt="0%")
        put(ws, f"F{r}", "Derived"); put(ws, f"G{r}", note, F_NOTE, wrap=True)
        for nmx, col in ((f"AL_RDMix{g}", "C"), (f"AL_RDMix{g}_Lo", "D"), (f"AL_RDMix{g}_Hi", "E")):
            v529._nm(wb, nmx, f"Alloc_In!${col}${r}")
        out[g] = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "研發世代組合合計（應為 100%；Checks Z2）")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", "=AL_RDMixHopper+AL_RDMixGB200+AL_RDMixGB300+AL_RDMixVR200", F_CALC, fmt="0%")
    out["sum"] = r
    RDIN_ROWS.update(out)
    return out


# ================================================================== Alloc J／K／L sections (appended after the I section; nothing above moves)
def alloc_sections(wb, R):
    from block6 import _row_of
    ws = wb["Alloc"]
    CF = "CDEF"
    r = ws.max_row + 2
    col = lambda c: f"{c}${R['col']}"
    gi = lambda c: f"{c}${R['genidx']}"
    tr = wb["Training"]
    r104 = _row_of(tr, "後訓練 GPU 小時（SFT＋RL＋蒸餾）"); r18 = _row_of(tr, "每 GW GPU 數")

    def row(key, label, unit, f, fmt, name=None, span=None, note=None, fill=False):
        nonlocal r
        put(ws, f"A{r}", label, wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", unit)
        if isinstance(f, dict):
            for c, v in f.items(): put(ws, f"{c}{r}", v, fmt=fmt, fill=FILL_KEY if fill else None)
        else:
            put(ws, f"C{r}", f, fmt=fmt, fill=FILL_KEY if fill else None)
        if note: put(ws, f"G{r}", note, F_NOTE)
        AM[key] = r
        if name:
            ref = f"Alloc!$C${r}" if span is None else f"Alloc!${span[0]}${r}:${span[1]}${r}"
            wb.defined_names[name] = DefinedName(name, attr_text=ref)
        r += 1

    # ---------------- J. R&D generation mix (L3)
    section(ws, r, "J. 研發世代組合（v8.0 L3；欄 C–F＝Hopper／GB200／GB300／VR200）：研發 GW 年與研發持有成本依 2025 研發世代組合（Alloc_In）加權；各世代以 GW 占比計，家族／改版計畫 GW 年取調和加權"
                   "（固定算力需求在各世代上的 GW 年 ＝ 1 ÷ Σ（占比 ÷ 該世代 GW 年），同服務側產能加權），持有成本取占比加權；不可達世代依 D8 排除並重新正規化，被排除占比另列", 7); r += 1
    row("j_share", "研發世代組合占比（Alloc_In；2025；GW 占比）", "%", {"C": "=AL_RDMixHopper", "D": "=AL_RDMixGB200", "E": "=AL_RDMixGB300", "F": "=AL_RDMixVR200"}, "0%", "AL_RDShareGen", ("C", "F"))
    for t, (tk, tn) in enumerate(TIERS, 1):
        row(f"j_fam{t}", f"家族計畫 GW 年 — {tn}（IF_ProgGWyr_{tk}；各世代；含研發倍數）", "GW·年",
            {c: f"=INDEX(IF_ProgGWyr_{tk},1,{col(c)})" for c in CF}, "0.00000")
    for t, (tk, tn) in enumerate(TIERS, 1):
        p = lambda c, t=t: f"INDEX(Training!$C${r104}:$Q${r104},3*({gi(c)}-1)+{t})"
        g_ = lambda c, t=t: f"INDEX(Training!$C${r18}:$Q${r18},3*({gi(c)}-1)+{t})"
        row(f"j_ref{t}", f"改版計畫 GW 年 — {tn}（後訓練 GPU 小時 × 研發倍數 ÷（每 GW GPU 數 × 8,760）；各世代）", "GW·年",
            {c: f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({p(c)}),ISNUMBER({g_(c)})),{p(c)}*IF_RDMult/({g_(c)}*8760),"{SLO}")' for c in CF}, "0.00000")
    nums = lambda c: ",".join(f"ISNUMBER({c}{AM[k]})" for k in ("j_fam1", "j_fam2", "j_fam3", "j_ref1", "j_ref2", "j_ref3"))
    row("j_ok", "可用於研發（三個層級的家族與改版計畫 GW 年皆為數值＝1；否則排除，D8）", "旗標", {c: f"=IF(AND({nums(c)}),1,0)" for c in CF}, "0", "AL_RDGenOK", ("C", "F"))
    row("j_oks", "研發組合中可用世代的占比合計（重新正規化的分母）", "%", f"=SUMPRODUCT(C{AM['j_share']}:F{AM['j_share']},C{AM['j_ok']}:F{AM['j_ok']})", "0.0%", "AL_RDShareOK")
    row("j_excl", "被排除的研發組合占比（世代的家族或改版計畫不可達）", "%", f"=SUM(C{AM['j_share']}:F{AM['j_share']})-C{AM['j_oks']}", "0.0%", "AL_RDShareExcl",
        note="D8：不可達＝不可用，排除並重新正規化，不靜默；基準為 0")
    row("j_w", "研發世代權重（重新正規化後；不可用世代為 0）", "%", {c: f"=IF(AND({c}{AM['j_ok']}=1,AL_RDShareOK>0),{c}{AM['j_share']}/AL_RDShareOK,0)" for c in CF}, "0.0%", "AL_RDWeight", ("C", "F"))
    w = lambda c: f"{c}{AM['j_w']}"

    def harm(rows_by_gen):
        den = "+".join(f"IF({w(c)}>0,{w(c)}/{c}{rows_by_gen},0)" for c in CF)
        return f'=IF(AL_RDShareOK>0,1/({den}),"{SLO}")'
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "層級", F_BOLD)
    for c, (tk, tn) in zip("CDE", TIERS): put(ws, f"{c}{r}", tn, F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"F{r}", "合計", F_BOLD); r += 1
    fam = {c: harm(AM[f"j_fam{t}"]) for t, c in zip((1, 2, 3), "CDE")}
    fam["F"] = f'=IF(COUNT(C{r}:E{r})=3,SUM(C{r}:E{r}),"{SLO}")'
    row("j_famb", "家族計畫 GW 年（研發組合加權；每層級 1 ÷ Σ（權重 ÷ 該世代家族計畫 GW 年）；→ 第 46 列 AL_FamGWyr）", "GW·年", fam, "0.00000")
    rf = {c: harm(AM[f"j_ref{t}"]) for t, c in zip((1, 2, 3), "CDE")}
    rf["F"] = f'=IF(COUNT(C{r}:E{r})=3,SUM(C{r}:E{r}),"{SLO}")'
    row("j_refb", "改版計畫 GW 年（研發組合加權；調和；→ 第 49 列 AL_RefGWyr）", "GW·年", rf, "0.00000")
    row("j_hold", "研發世代每 GW 年經濟持有成本（權重 × 各世代 IF_HoldEcon；→ 第 52 列 AL_HoldTrain）", "$B/GW/年",
        f'=IF(AL_RDShareOK>0,SUMPRODUCT(C{AM["j_w"]}:F{AM["j_w"]},C{R["hold"]}:F{R["hold"]}),"{SLO}")', "0.000", "AL_HoldRD")
    v7 = lambda tk: f"INDEX(IF_ProgGWyr_{tk},1,AL_TrainCol)"
    row("j_famv", "對照：單一訓練世代（IF_TrainGenDefault＝VR200）家族計畫 GW 年（v7.0 口徑）", "GW·年",
        f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({v7("Luna")}),ISNUMBER({v7("Sol")}),ISNUMBER({v7("Astra")})),{v7("Luna")}+{v7("Sol")}+{v7("Astra")},"{SLO}")', "0.00000")
    pv = lambda c: f"IF(AND(ISNUMBER({c}{R['post']}),ISNUMBER({c}{R['gpugw']})),{c}{R['post']}*IF_RDMult/({c}{R['gpugw']}*8760),\"{SLO}\")"
    row("j_refv", "對照：單一訓練世代改版計畫 GW 年（v7.0 口徑；第 47–48 列）", "GW·年",
        f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER({pv("C")}),ISNUMBER({pv("D")}),ISNUMBER({pv("E")})),{pv("C")}+{pv("D")}+{pv("E")},"{SLO}")', "0.00000")
    row("j_rdv", "對照：研發 GW 年（單一訓練世代口徑，v7.0）", "GW·年",
        f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(C{AM["j_famv"]}),ISNUMBER(C{AM["j_refv"]})),AL_k*(AL_Nmajor*C{AM["j_famv"]}+AL_Nrefresh*C{AM["j_refv"]}),"{SLO}")', "0.0000")
    row("j_rdr", "研發 GW 年（研發組合）÷ 單一訓練世代口徑", "x", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_RDGW),ISNUMBER(C{AM["j_rdv"]})),IF(C{AM["j_rdv"]}>0,AL_RDGW/C{AM["j_rdv"]},"{SLO}"),"{SLO}")', "0.000",
        note="研發改用較舊世代（每 GW 產出較低）→ 同樣的算力需求占用更多 GW 年，比值 > 1")
    row("j_holdr", "研發持有成本（研發組合）÷ 訓練世代（VR200）持有成本", "x", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_HoldRD),ISNUMBER(INDEX(IF_HoldEcon,1,AL_TrainCol))),AL_HoldRD/INDEX(IF_HoldEcon,1,AL_TrainCol),"{SLO}")', "0.000")
    r += 1

    # ---------------- K. 2025 annual price and fleet breakeven (L1, L4)
    section(ws, r, "K. 2025 年度單價與機隊損益兩平（v8.0 L1／L4；欄 C–F＝Hopper／GB200／GB300／VR200）：2025 層級單價（Cap_In M 節）依 K1 的可達層級重新正規化；機隊損益兩平＝服務世代組合持有成本 ÷ 2025 單價下的每 GW 營收", 7); r += 1
    flags = lambda c: [f"{c}{R[k]}" for k in ("rl", "rs", "ra")]

    def pg25(suf):
        price = {tn: f"CAP_Px25_{tn}{suf}" for tn, _ in TIERS}
        out = {}
        for c in CF:
            num = "+".join(f"IF({f}=1,INDEX(B4_MixPaid,1,{t})*{price[tn]},0)" for t, (f, (tn, _)) in enumerate(zip(flags(c), TIERS), 1))
            out[c] = f'=IF({c}{R["ok"]}=1,({num})*(1-B4_Disc)/{c}{R["wp"]},"{SLO}")'
        return out
    row("k_pg", "各世代付費 token 2025 混合有效單價＝Σ（可達層級的付費組合權重 × 該層級 2025 單價）×（1 − B4_Disc）÷ 可達層級權重合計（全不可達的世代為文字）", "$/M", pg25(""), "0.0000", "AL_PriceGen25", ("C", "F"),
        note="與第 119 列（2026 快照）同一組可達層級；v9.0 起基準下全層級可達")
    row("k_pgl", "同上（2025 單價低端）", "$/M", pg25("_Lo"), "0.0000", "AL_PriceGen25_Lo", ("C", "F"))
    row("k_pgh", "同上（2025 單價高端）", "$/M", pg25("_Hi"), "0.0000", "AL_PriceGen25_Hi", ("C", "F"))
    ss = [f"{c}${R['share']}" for c in CF]; ok = [f"{c}${R['ok']}" for c in CF]; cp = [f"{c}${R['capp']}" for c in CF]

    def fleet_px(rowkey):
        pgc = [f"{c}${AM[rowkey]}" for c in CF]
        num = "+".join(f"IF(AND({s}>0,{o}=1),{s}*{k}*{p},0)" for s, o, k, p in zip(ss, ok, cp, pgc))
        return f'IF(AL_BlendPaid="{GENX}","{GENX}",IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_BlendPaid),AL_GenShareOK>0),IF(AL_BlendPaid>0,({num})/AL_GenShareOK/AL_BlendPaid,"{SLO}"),"{SLO}"))'
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊口徑 2025 混合有效單價＝Σ（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能 × 各世代 2025 單價）÷ Σ（世代占比 × 各世代付費產能）；C 基準、D 低端、E 高端　→ Cap_In H7／H10 m_fleet", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$/M")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", "=" + fleet_px("k_pg"), fmt="0.0000", fill=FILL_KEY); put(ws, f"D{r}", "=" + fleet_px("k_pgl"), fmt="0.0000"); put(ws, f"E{r}", "=" + fleet_px("k_pgh"), fmt="0.0000")
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "分子分母同為可達層級、可服務世代，與機隊付費 token（AL_BlendPaid 加權）同口徑；H7 讀 C 欄", F_NOTE)
    for nmx, c in (("AL_PriceFleet25", "C"), ("AL_PriceFleet25_Lo", "D"), ("AL_PriceFleet25_Hi", "E")):
        wb.defined_names[nmx] = DefinedName(nmx, attr_text=f"Alloc!${c}${r}")
    AM["k_pf"] = r; r += 1
    row("k_pfr", "機隊口徑 2025 單價 ÷ 2026 快照機隊口徑單價（AL_PriceFleet）", "x", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(C{AM["k_pf"]}),ISNUMBER(AL_PriceFleet)),C{AM["k_pf"]}/AL_PriceFleet,C{AM["k_pf"]})', "0.0000")
    row("k_rev", "各世代每 GW 付費營收（2025 單價）＝IF_RevGWFleet（該世代基準欄）× 2025 單價 ÷ 2026 單價（同一組可達層級與付費 token，只換單價；IF_Util 基準）", "$B/GW/年",
        {c: (f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(INDEX(IF_RevGWFleet,1,{col(c)})),ISNUMBER({c}{AM["k_pg"]}),ISNUMBER({c}{R["pg"]})),IF({c}{R["pg"]}>0,INDEX(IF_RevGWFleet,1,{col(c)})*{c}{AM["k_pg"]}/{c}{R["pg"]},"{SLO}"),"{SLO}")') for c in CF},
        "0.000", "AL_RevGW25", ("C", "F"), note="IF_RevGWFleet＝Fleet_1GW 付費 token × 2026 單價（Theory_Rev 第 67 列），故可依單價比例換算")
    row("k_holdl", "各世代每 GW 年經濟持有成本 — 低成本欄", "$B/GW/年", {c: f"=INDEX(IF_HoldEcon,1,{col(c)}-1)" for c in CF}, "0.000", "AL_HoldGen_Lo", ("C", "F"))
    row("k_holdh", "各世代每 GW 年經濟持有成本 — 高成本欄", "$B/GW/年", {c: f"=INDEX(IF_HoldEcon,1,{col(c)}+1)" for c in CF}, "0.000", "AL_HoldGen_Hi", ("C", "F"))
    ss_ = [f"{c}${R['share']}" for c in CF]

    def wavg(rownum):
        terms = "+".join(f"IF(AND({s}>0,{o}=1),{s}*{c}${rownum},0)" for s, o, c in zip(ss_, ok, CF))
        return f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_BlendPaid),AL_GenShareOK>0),({terms})/AL_GenShareOK,{UN})'
    row("k_frev", "機隊每 GW 付費營收（2025 單價；服務世代組合加權，只含可服務世代）", "$B/GW/年", wavg(AM["k_rev"]), "0.000", "AL_FleetRev25")
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊每 GW 年持有成本（服務世代組合加權＝Σ 占比 × AL_HoldGen，只含可服務世代）；C 基準、D 低成本、E 高成本", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "$B/GW/年")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", wavg(R["hold"]), fmt="0.000"); put(ws, f"D{r}", wavg(AM["k_holdl"]), fmt="0.000"); put(ws, f"E{r}", wavg(AM["k_holdh"]), fmt="0.000")
    for nmx, c in (("AL_FleetHold", "C"), ("AL_FleetHold_Lo", "D"), ("AL_FleetHold_Hi", "E")):
        wb.defined_names[nmx] = DefinedName(nmx, attr_text=f"Alloc!${c}${r}")
    AM["k_fh"] = r; r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "機隊損益兩平乘積（2025 機隊口徑）＝機隊持有成本 ÷（機隊每 GW 營收 ÷ IF_Util）：令機隊營收＝持有成本所需的「利用率 × 折減 × L × m」；C 基準、D 低成本、E 高成本　→ L1_FleetBreakeven2025", wrap=True); put(ws, f"B{r}", "x")
    for c in "CDE":
        put(ws, f"{c}{r}", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_FleetRev25),ISNUMBER({c}{AM["k_fh"]})),IF(AL_FleetRev25>0,{c}{AM["k_fh"]}/(AL_FleetRev25/IF_Util),{UN}),{UN})', fmt="0.0000", fill=FILL_KEY if c == "C" else None)
    put(ws, f"G{r}", "取代 L1_FleetBreakeven（VR200 截面）作為所需 L 的損益兩平；成本與營收同為服務世代組合（Hopper 0.6／GB200 0.4）、同為 2025 單價", F_NOTE)
    for nmx, c in (("AL_FleetBE25", "C"), ("AL_FleetBE25_Lo", "D"), ("AL_FleetBE25_Hi", "E")):
        wb.defined_names[nmx] = DefinedName(nmx, attr_text=f"Alloc!${c}${r}")
    AM["k_be"] = r; r += 2

    # ---------------- L. token route comparison rows (L5)
    section(ws, r, "L. token 路線對照（v8.0 L5，D14）：Q1、Q2、服務 GW 的主口徑為支出路線（D 節與 Interface F 節）；本節保留 token 路線作對照，兩者差距列「未解釋」（需求 D、每 GW 產能、支出口徑三者之一偏離）", 7); r += 1
    row("l_q1", "Q1_Tok（token 路線）＝研發 GW ÷（研發 GW＋token 路線服務 GW）", "%",
        f'=IF(AL_ServeGW="{GENX}","{GENX}",IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_ServeGW),ISNUMBER(AL_RDGW)),AL_RDGW/(AL_RDGW+AL_ServeGW),"{SLO}"))', "0.0%", "AL_Q1_Tok")
    row("l_q2", "Q2_Tok（token 路線）＝研發 GW × 持有成本 ÷（＋Σ 各世代服務 GW × 各世代持有成本）", "%",
        f'=IF(AL_ServeGW="{GENX}","{GENX}",IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_ServeGW),ISNUMBER(AL_RDGW)),AL_RDGW*AL_HoldTrain/(AL_RDGW*AL_HoldTrain+SUMPRODUCT(AL_ServeGen,AL_HoldGen)),"{SLO}"))', "0.0%", "AL_Q2_Tok")
    row("l_gw", "服務 GW 差距（支出路線 − token 路線；未解釋）", "GW", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_ServeGW),ISNUMBER(AL_ServeGWSpend)),AL_ServeGWSpend-AL_ServeGW,{UN})', "0.0000",
        note="＝L1_ScaleServe 的絕對值版本；差距不分配到需求 D、每 GW 產能或支出口徑（D14）")
    row("l_q1d", "Q1 差距（支出路線 − token 路線；百分點）", "%", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_Q1),ISNUMBER(AL_Q1_Tok)),AL_Q1-AL_Q1_Tok,{UN})', "0.0%")
    row("l_q2d", "Q2 差距（支出路線 − token 路線；百分點）", "%", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER(AL_Q2),ISNUMBER(AL_Q2_Tok)),AL_Q2-AL_Q2_Tok,{UN})', "0.0%")
    AM["end"] = r - 1
    return dict(AM)


def alloc_patch(wb, R):
    """L3: rows 46／49 (C–E per tier) and 52 now read the Alloc J section (single-generation VR200 reading kept in J as a comparison); labels updated. Returns a log."""
    ws = wb["Alloc"]; log = []
    for c in "CDE":
        ws[f"{c}{R['fam']}"].value = f"={c}{AM['j_famb']}"
        ws[f"{c}{R['ref']}"].value = f"={c}{AM['j_refb']}"
    ws[f"C{R['ht']}"].value = f"=C{AM['j_hold']}"
    ws[f"A{R['fam']}"].value = "家族計畫 GW 年（v8.0 L3：2025 研發世代組合加權，J 節；單一訓練世代 VR200 的 v7.0 口徑見 J 節對照列；含研發倍數）"
    ws[f"A{R['ref']}"].value = "改版計畫 GW 年（v8.0 L3：研發世代組合加權，J 節；第 47–48 列為訓練世代 VR200 對照輸入）＝後訓練 GPU 小時 × 研發倍數 ÷（每 GW GPU 數 × 8,760）"
    ws[f"A{R['ht']}"].value = "研發世代每 GW 年經濟持有成本（v8.0 L3：研發世代組合 × 各世代 IF_HoldEcon，J 節；v7.0 為訓練世代 VR200）"
    ws[f"A{R['rd']}"].value = "研發 GW 年＝k ×（N_major × 家族計畫＋N_refresh × 改版計畫）（v8.0 L3：2025 研發世代組合加權）"
    log.append("Alloc rows %d／%d／%d: read the J section (v8.0 L3)" % (R["fam"], R["ref"], R["ht"]))
    # price row labels: the 2026 snapshot stays; the 2025 annual price is in K
    pf = int(wb.defined_names["AL_PriceFleet"].attr_text.split("$")[-1])
    a = ws[f"A{pf}"].value
    tail = "（2026 快照單價；v8.0 起 m 與回本比較改讀 K 節 AL_PriceFleet25，2025 年度單價）"
    if tail not in a: ws[f"A{pf}"].value = a + tail; log.append(f"Alloc!A{pf}: label")
    return log


# ================================================================== Interface K section (appended at the end) and Checks Z2
def interface_k(wb):
    ws = wb["Interface"]
    start = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, start, "K. 服務 GW 的 token 路線對照（v8.0 L5，D14）：IF_AllocServeGW 為支出路線主口徑；本列保留 token 路線供對照，兩者差距未解釋（L1_ScaleServe）", 17)
    r = start + 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "服務 GW 合計（token 路線；付費＋免費；IT 關鍵電力；對照用，v8.0 D14 起不是主口徑）　[IF_AllocServeGW_Tok]"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "GW")
    put(ws, f"C{r}", "=AL_ServeGW", fmt="0.0000")
    wb.defined_names["IF_AllocServeGW_Tok"] = DefinedName("IF_AllocServeGW_Tok", attr_text=f"Interface!$C${r}")
    return dict(start=start, row=r)


def checks_z2(wb):
    ws = wb["Checks"]
    r = max(c.row for row in ws.iter_rows() for c in row if c.value is not None) + 2
    section(ws, r, "Z2. 研發世代組合檢查（工作單 稽核修正2 4r1 L3，v8.0）：Z2 為 ERROR 計入 GOV_Errors", 6); r += 1
    for i, h in enumerate(["編號", "檢查", "等級", "筆數", "範圍與算法"]): put(ws, f"{'ABCDE'[i]}{r}", h, F_BOLD)
    r += 1
    put(ws, f"A{r}", "Z2"); put(ws, f"B{r}", "研發世代組合 Hopper＋GB200＋GB300＋VR200（Alloc_In，2025）合計 ≠ 100%（容差 1e-9）"); put(ws, f"C{r}", "ERROR", F_BOLD)
    put(ws, f"D{r}", "=IF(ABS(AL_RDMixHopper+AL_RDMixGB200+AL_RDMixGB300+AL_RDMixVR200-1)>1E-9,1,0)", fmt="0")
    put(ws, f"E{r}", "Alloc_In 研發世代組合四格（基準欄）", F_NOTE)
    ref = wb.defined_names["GOV_Errors"].attr_text.split("!")[1].replace("$", "")
    cell = ws[ref]
    if f"D{r}" not in str(cell.value): cell.value = f"{cell.value}+D{r}"
    ws[f"B{int(ref[1:])}"].value = "ERROR 合計（CI 讀取 GOV_Errors；含 G、H、X、Y、Z、Z2 節）"
    wb.defined_names["CHK_RDMixSum"] = DefinedName("CHK_RDMixSum", attr_text=f"Checks!$D${r}")
    return r

def l1_patch(R):
    out = []
    for row in R:
        row = list(row)
        key = row[0]
        if key == "MFleet":
            row[1] = row[1] + MFLEET_TAIL
            row[2] = ("OpenAI 2025；毛額營收 SRC_DEM_007 ÷（機隊付費 token（點估計）× 2025 年度機隊口徑混合有效單價 AL_PriceFleet25）；v8.0 L1（D2）：單價由 2026 快照改為 2025 年度；"
                      "v7.0 的值保留為 L1_MFleet_Px2026")
        elif key == "LReqFleet":
            row[1] = "回本所需壽命期價格係數 L（2025 機隊口徑；m＝L1_MFleet）"
            row[2] = "L1_FleetBreakeven2025 ÷（IF_Util × CTL_ProdDerate × L1_MFleet）；v8.0 L4：成本與營收同為服務世代組合、2025 單價；VR200 舊口徑見 L1_LReqFleet_VR200"
            row[7] = ("回本所需 L＝L1_FleetBreakeven2025 ÷（IF_Util × CTL_ProdDerate × m）：給定 m，L 至少要多少才達 2025 機隊回本。與 L_total 並列判讀（Cap_In 第 242 列）。"
                      "v7.0 的 VR200 口徑（0.530）保留為 L1_LReqFleet_VR200；兩者口徑不同，不可互比。恆等式讀法見 L1_LReqFleet_Id")
            row[8] = "機隊回本門檻（2025 機隊口徑）、利用率、生產折減、機隊 m"
        elif key == "PriceRealFleet":
            row[2] = "OpenAI 2025；m_fleet × 2025 年度機隊口徑單價（Alloc AL_PriceFleet25；v8.0 L1）；v5.36 B6"
            for k in (3, 4, 5): row[k] = _px(row[k])
        elif key == "PriceReqBE":
            row[2] = "L1_FleetBreakeven2025 ÷（IF_Util × CTL_ProdDerate）× 2025 年度機隊口徑單價（AL_PriceFleet25）÷ L_total；v8.0 L4"
            for k in (3, 4, 5): row[k] = _px(re.sub(r"\bL1_FleetBreakeven\b", "L1_FleetBreakeven2025", row[k]))
        elif key == "FleetBreakeven":
            row[1] = "機隊損益兩平乘積（_Util 層；VR200 截面，非 2025 機隊）：令機隊營收（IF_RevGWFleet，_Util 層）＝持有成本所需的「利用率 × 折減 × L × m」（VR200）"
            row[8] = row[8] + "。v8.0 L4：維持 VR200 截面（Checks K4 比對的恆等式、契約內已列）；2025 機隊口徑見 L1_FleetBreakeven2025，所需 L 讀後者"
        elif key == "FleetMargin":
            row[1] = row[1].replace("（四層口徑：", "（VR200 截面，非 2025 機隊；四層口徑：")
        elif key == "ExtServeGW":
            row[1] = "服務 GW：token 路線（對照）對 支出路線（D14 主口徑）"
            row[2] = "OpenAI 2025；v8.0 D14：IF_AllocServeGW 已改為支出路線，本列以 token 路線（IF_AllocServeGW_Tok，需求 D ÷ 每 GW 產能）為推算、支出路線（推論支出 ÷ 持有成本）為外部對照，差距未解釋"
            assert row[3] == "=IF_AllocServeGW", row[3]
            row[3] = row[4] = row[5] = "=IF_AllocServeGW_Tok"
        elif key == "ScaleServe":
            row[1] = "服務端落差（未解釋）：支出路線服務 GW ÷ token 路線服務 GW（Alloc F 節 ÷ B 節）"
            row[2] = "Decision Use＝下游校準用，不得當產能；X14 (g)；v8.0 D14：主口徑已改支出路線，本列改標為兩路線的未解釋差距，數值不變"
            if "SRC_DEM_018" in row[11]: row[11] = row[11].replace("SRC_DEM_018", "SRC_DEM_004")
        elif key == "PretrainFLOP_Astra_Ext":
            row[1] = "Astra 預訓練算力（external-anchor：Epoch GPT-6 Astra 估計；叢集總算力，含後訓練，為上限）"
            row[2] = "SRC_MOD_055（低高＝_Lo／_Hi）；X14 (f)；v8.0 D14：Epoch 1.0e27 標為上限（GPT-6 Astra 叢集總算力，含後訓練）；隱含 token 見 L1_AstraExtTok_*B"
        elif key == "AstraScale":
            row[1] = "Astra 規模係數（未解釋）：Epoch 上限 ÷ 模型 bottom-up"
            row[2] = "X14 (f)；v8.0 D14：差距分配到參數、token 或後訓練，不在本版決定；數值不變"
        out.append(tuple(row))
    return out

SEC_K_OLD = "C＝2025 年度（Alloc 的 AL_PriceFleet）"
SEC_K_NEW = "C＝2025 年度（Alloc K 節的 AL_PriceFleet25，2025 年度層級單價；v8.0 L1，v7.0 為 2026 快照 AL_PriceFleet）"

LAB_K268_NEW = "對照：完整層級組合混合有效單價（C 欄＝2025 年度，Cap_In M 節 CAP_Price25Mix；D–F 欄＝第 90 列 2026 快照；需求路線的模型 token 用第 90 列）"


def text_update(wb, append_text):
    log = []
    ci = wb["Cap_In"]
    ref = wb.defined_names["B4_PriceFleet"].attr_text.split("!")[1].replace("$", "")
    k_row = int("".join(ch for ch in ref.split(":")[0] if ch.isdigit()))
    if ci[f"C{k_row}"].value == "=AL_PriceFleet":
        ci[f"C{k_row}"].value = "=AL_PriceFleet25"; log.append(f"Cap_In!C{k_row}: =AL_PriceFleet25 (v8.0 L1)")
    for rr in range(k_row - 3, k_row):
        a = ci.cell(rr, 1).value
        if isinstance(a, str) and SEC_K_OLD in a:
            ci.cell(rr, 1).value = a.replace(SEC_K_OLD, SEC_K_NEW); log.append(f"Cap_In!A{rr}: K section title (v8.0)")
    if ci[f"A{k_row + 1}"].value == LAB_K268_OLD:
        ci[f"A{k_row + 1}"].value = LAB_K268_NEW
        if ci[f"C{k_row + 1}"].value == "=$C$90": ci[f"C{k_row + 1}"].value = f"=$C${CM['mix25']}"
        log.append(f"Cap_In!C{k_row + 1}: 2025 full-tier price (v8.0)")
    return log

                  f"Train_In 第 16 列與 Training 頁不動；四格合計 100%（Checks Z2）")

        out.append({'scope': sc, 'sheet': 'Alloc_In', 'cell': f'D{r}:E{r}', 'label': lab, 'check': lab, 'cls': 'Derived', 'role': '低／高', 'src': '', 'rel': '', 'dec': 'AF2d-L3',
```

```python
import re

from gov_seed3 import SRC_RECORDS3, EVID_MIG3, DECISIONS_V515, DEC_STATUS_V515, GOV_MAP_V515
import v518                       # v5.18: Stage 2 first write batch (Excel-owned writes with old-value guards; see v518.py)

import v603                       # v6.3: audit fix 2-1b (K1 fleet price, K2 whole-generation flag, K3 TTFT cost rows, J1 r1)
import v601                       # v6.1: audit fix 3B (D3／D6／D10／D13／Q3／Q6 judgement columns, Gov_Map rows, Decisions AF3B-*)
import v536                       # v5.36: token-denominator closure (SRC_DEM_073, Gov_Map rows, L1 patches／new rows, E344–E365, X45–X47)
import v535                       # v5.35: L split (SRC_DEM_072, Gov_Map I-section／H10 rows and GM629–GM633 re-pointing, L1_LPrice…, E338–E343, X42–X44)
import v534                       # v5.34: m split (SRC_DEM_069–071, SRC_DEM_042／060 notes, Gov_Map H8／H10 rows and GM441／GM442 range text, L1_MAPI…, E325–E337, X35–X41)
import v533                       # v5.33: paid-token calibration (SRC_DEM_049–068, SRC_DEM_007／009／045 notes, Gov_Map J8／J9／GM594 notes and H7 rows, L1_MFleet／L1_TokCeiling, E302–E324, X27–X34)
import v532                       # v5.32: m tracking (SRC_DEM_019–048, SRC_DEM_018 note, Gov_Map GM594 note and Cap_In H rows, L1_MImplied／_Ext, E279–E301, X21–X26)
import v531                       # v5.31: J1–J6 (formula map E12／E13／Inputs E36, SRC records and updates, Gov_Map, L1 IREN row, E263–E278, X16–X20)
import v530                       # v5.30: X15 (b) L1_HoldEconMW_*, Decisions X15a–c
import v529                       # v5.29: X14 (SRC_DEM_018 replaces 004, Alloc_In inputs, E256–E262, Decisions X14a–m／G16, Gov_Map notes, L1 rows, SRC_Price columns, SRC_Index date column)
import v527                       # v5.27: X13 (SRC_MOD_055 low／high, SRC_MOD_057–062 Kimi K3, E251–E255, E249 note, Gov_Map notes, Decisions X13, L1 rows 36／39)
import v525                       # v5.25: X12 evidence (SRC_DEM_014–017, SRC_MOD_055, E247–E250), GM248 range, Decisions X11／X12, L1 row 36 comparison
import v524                       # v5.24: SRC_Perf note wording (rows 60–63, old phrase removed)
import v523                       # v5.23: X10 (Gov_Map row, Decisions), SRC_Perf note wording
import v522                       # v5.22: X7 (L, m side-by-side outputs: Gov_Map rows, Decisions), X8 evidence E246, X9 Q2 second sources

ALL_RECORDS = SRC_RECORDS + SRC_RECORDS2 + SRC_RECORDS3
ALL_PERF_ATTR = {**PERF_ATTR, **PERF_ATTR2}
ALL_FORMULA_MAP = {**FORMULA_MAP, **FORMULA_MAP2}
def _fm(): return v531.formula_map(v518.formula_map(ALL_FORMULA_MAP))     # v5.18: steps (C44, C69, G2, G4, E3, RU) add or drop links; v5.31 X16／X18: Spec_Rack E12 dropped, E13 -> SRC_HW_010, Inputs E36 -> SRC_DC_015

SRC_SHEETS = ["SRC_HW", "SRC_DC", "SRC_Model", "SRC_Perf", "SRC_Price", "SRC_Cap", "SRC_Harness", "SRC_Demand"]   # v5.13: +4
SRC_LAST = 400                      # record rows 5..SRC_LAST (formula ranges)
SRC_HDR = ["SRC_ID", "指標", "數值", "低", "高", "單位", "口徑", "適用對象", "日期", "出處", "來源等級", "立場", "立場說明",
           "一手／二手", "狀態", "取代者", "Evidence ID", "第二來源 SRC_ID", "審查日", "Andy 原話", "原 S 編號", "模型使用位置", "備註",
           "同指標同口徑 Active 數（公式）", "缺 Evidence（公式）", "利害關係方缺第二來源（公式）"]
PERF_HDR = ["平台", "軟體／日期", "ISL", "OSL", "每用戶速度 tok/s", "MTP（1＝有）", "token 口徑"]
PERF_NAMES = {"AC": "_ISL", "AD": "_OSL", "AE": "_Spd", "AF": "_MTP"}
SRC_TITLE = {"SRC_HW": "晶片與機架的規格、功率、價格", "SRC_DC": "廠房資本支出、電價、折舊慣例、外部成本參照",
             "SRC_Model": "模型架構與訓練揭露", "SRC_Perf": "推論與訓練量測（InferenceX、MLPerf、自揭）及量測條件",
             "SRC_Price": "API 牌價與算力租金（廠商牌價、新雲價目、第三方推算）", "SRC_Cap": "能力評測（Artificial Analysis 指數、METR 時間範圍）",
             "SRC_Harness": "harness 與代理的 token 倍數、成功率、成本（ARC-AGI-3、廠商揭露）", "SRC_Demand": "需求與支出揭露（實驗室推論／訓練支出、營收、算力規模）"}
DASH = "—"


def _nm(wb, n, ref):
    if n in wb.defined_names: del wb.defined_names[n]
    wb.defined_names[n] = DefinedName(n, attr_text=ref)


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 1. Source sheets (Excel-owned after creation)
def src_sheets(wb):
    made = []
    for sh in SRC_SHEETS:
        if sh in wb.sheetnames: continue
        ws = wb.create_sheet(sh); made.append(sh)
        title(ws, f"{sh} — 第 0 層 Source：{SRC_TITLE[sh]}",
              "只存已取得的原始訊息（非計算、非假設；G1）。藍字＝原始值，由本活頁簿擁有；模型頁以公式連結 SRC_ID 具名範圍。"
              "新訊息先登錄 DB_Evidence，比較後擇優寫入（G2–G6）。X–Z 欄為檢查公式（builder 每次重建）。")
        put(ws, "A3", "來源等級：A＝Andy、1＝一手且已讀原文、2＝二手已讀或一手文件轉載、3＝模型內建知識、只見摘錄或待查核（G0-7）。"
                      "狀態：Active／Alt（口徑不同或多家獨立估計並列，G13）／Superseded。", F_NOTE)
        hdr = SRC_HDR + (PERF_HDR if sh == "SRC_Perf" else [])
        widths = [13, 40, 11, 9, 9, 13, 22, 20, 11, 40, 6, 10, 30, 12, 10, 10, 16, 14, 9, 12, 8, 30, 36, 10, 10, 10] + [16, 22, 7, 7, 9, 8, 14]
        for i, h in enumerate(hdr):
            put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}4", h, F_BOLD, wrap=True); ws.column_dimensions[L(i+1)].width = widths[i]
        r = 5
        for rec in [x for x in ALL_RECORDS if x["sheet"] == sh]:
            _src_row(ws, r, rec); r += 1
        ws.freeze_panes = "C5"
    return made


def _src_row(ws, r, rec):
    vals = [rec["id"], rec["metric"], rec["val"], rec["lo"], rec["hi"], rec["unit"], rec["basis"] or DASH, rec["applies"] or DASH,
            str(rec["date"]), rec["src"] or DASH, rec["grade"], rec["stance"], rec["stance_note"] or DASH, rec["hand"] or DASH,
            rec["status"], DASH, rec["ev"], DASH, DASH, DASH, rec["s"], rec["use"] or DASH, rec["note"] or DASH]
    for i, v in enumerate(vals):
        f = F_IN if i in (2, 3, 4) and isinstance(v, (int, float)) else F_CALC
        put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}{r}", v, f, wrap=i in (1, 9, 12, 21, 22))
    if ws.title == "SRC_Perf" and rec["id"] in ALL_PERF_ATTR:
        a = ALL_PERF_ATTR[rec["id"]]
        for col, k in zip(["AA", "AB", "AC", "AD", "AE", "AF", "AG"], ["platform", "software", "isl", "osl", "spd", "mtp", "tok"]):
            if a[k] is not None or rec["id"] in PERF_ATTR: put(ws, f"{col}{r}", a[k], F_IN if isinstance(a[k], (int, float)) else F_CALC)


def src_append(wb):
    """v5.13: records of SRC_RECORDS2 whose sheet already exists (S30 → SRC_Perf) are appended after its last record, only when
    the ID is absent anywhere on that sheet (Excel-owned afterwards; an ID Andy deleted or renamed is not re-added if its row moved)."""
    added = []
    for rec in SRC_RECORDS2 + SRC_RECORDS3 + v518.src_new_records() + v521.src_new_records() + v525.src_new_records() + v527.src_new_records() + v529.src_new_records() + v531.src_new_records() + v532.src_new_records() + v533.src_new_records() + v534.src_new_records() + v535.src_new_records() + v536.src_new_records() + v1000.src_new_records():
        ws = wb[rec["sheet"]]
        ids = {ws.cell(r, 1).value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
        if rec["id"] in ids: continue
        last = max([r for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 1).value not in (None, "")] or [4])
        _src_row(ws, last + 1, rec); added.append(rec["id"])
    return added


KEY_COL, KEY_SEP = "AH", "¦"       # v5.12 (A): builder-owned key column (指標¦口徑¦適用對象, Active rows only) used by X
# v5.29 (work order 第 5 節): SRC_Price gained five tier columns at X–AB, so its check columns are AC／AD／AE and the key column AM
CHECK_COLS = {sh: ("X", "Y", "Z", KEY_COL) for sh in SRC_SHEETS}; CHECK_COLS["SRC_Price"] = ("AC", "AD", "AE", "AM")

def src_refresh(wb):
    """Helper formulas (X–Z, AH) for every record row, and SRC_ names (value／_Lo／_Hi／Perf attributes)."""
    n_names = 0; index = {}
    for sh in SRC_SHEETS:
        ws = wb[sh]
        cx, cy, cz, ck = CHECK_COLS[sh]
        put(ws, f"{ck}4", "同指標鍵（公式；X 欄用，v5.12）", F_BOLD, wrap=True); ws.column_dimensions[ck].width = 12
        # v5.14: X compares only rows 5..(last record + IDX_HEAD), the same span SRC_Index uses for this sheet (was 5..SRC_LAST).
        # A record beyond the span is already an ERROR (Checks E13, fixed by rebuilding), so the counts are unchanged; the
        # comparison arrays shrink from 8 × 396 to about 700 rows (X columns were ~40% of full-recalc time in v5.13).
        end = _span_end(ws)
        for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
            sid = ws.cell(r, 1).value
            if not (isinstance(sid, str) and sid.startswith("SRC_")): continue
            index[sid] = (sh, r)
            rng = lambda c: f"${c}$5:${c}${end}"
            # v5.12 (A): same count as v5.11 (B, G, H equal and Active) via one key column (AH) and one comparison array,
            # instead of four 396-row arrays per record (the SRC X columns were ~60% of full-recalc time after SRC_Index)
            put(ws, f"{ck}{r}", f'=IF($O{r}="Active",$B{r}&"{KEY_SEP}"&$G{r}&"{KEY_SEP}"&$H{r},"")')
            put(ws, f"{cx}{r}", f'=IF($O{r}="Active",SUMPRODUCT(({rng(ck)}=${ck}{r})*1),0)', fmt="0")
            put(ws, f"{cy}{r}", f'=IF(AND($O{r}="Active",OR($Q{r}="{DASH}",$Q{r}="")),1,0)', fmt="0")
            put(ws, f"{cz}{r}", f'=IF(AND($O{r}="Active",$L{r}="利害關係方",OR($R{r}="{DASH}",$R{r}="")),1,0)', fmt="0")
            _nm(wb, sid, f"{sh}!$C${r}"); n_names += 1
            for col, suf in (("D", "_Lo"), ("E", "_Hi")):
                if ws[f"{col}{r}"].value is not None: _nm(wb, sid + suf, f"{sh}!${col}${r}"); n_names += 1
            if sh == "SRC_Perf":
                for col, suf in PERF_NAMES.items():
                    if ws[f"{col}{r}"].value is not None: _nm(wb, sid + suf, f"{sh}!${col}${r}"); n_names += 1
    return n_names, index


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 2. DB_Evidence upgrade (Excel-owned)
EV_NEW_HDR = ["狀態（已處理／待判定／待 Andy）", "相關 SRC_ID", "取代者", "受影響 IF_／L1_", "來源等級", "立場"]

def evidence_upgrade(wb):
    ws = wb["DB_Evidence"]; added = 0
    if ws["L4"].value is None:
        for i, h in enumerate(EV_NEW_HDR):
            put(ws, f"{L(12+i)}4", h, F_BOLD, wrap=True); ws.column_dimensions[L(12+i)].width = [14, 30, 12, 20, 8, 12][i]
        put(ws, "A3", "v5.11：新增 L–Q 欄（G2 流程的狀態、相關 SRC_ID、取代者、受影響名稱、等級、立場）；E101 起為 Stage 1 遷移紀錄。", F_NOTE)
    have = {ws.cell(r, 1).value: r for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws.cell(r, 1).value}
    for eid, vals in EVID_UPD.items():
        r = have.get(eid)
        if r and ws.cell(r, 12).value is None:
            for i, v in enumerate(vals):
                put(ws, f"{L(12+i)}{r}", v if v != "" else DASH, F_CALC, wrap=i in (1, 5))
    r = max(have.values()) + 1 if have else 5
    for row in EVID_MIG + EVID_MIG2 + EVID_MIG3 + v518.evidence_rows() + v520.evidence_rows() + v521.evidence_rows() + v522.evidence_rows() + v525.evidence_rows() + v527.evidence_rows() + v529.evidence_rows() + v531.evidence_rows() + v532.evidence_rows() + v533.evidence_rows() + v534.evidence_rows() + v535.evidence_rows() + v536.evidence_rows() + v700.evidence_rows() + v800.evidence_rows() + v1000.evidence_rows():
        if row[0] in have: continue
        for i, v in enumerate(row):
            put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}{r}", v if v != "" else DASH, F_IN if i < 11 else F_CALC, wrap=i in (2, 10, 12))
        r += 1; added += 1
    return added

def apply_formula_map(wb):
    n = 0; log = []
    for key, f in _fm().items():
        sh, co = key.split("!")
        c = wb[sh][co]
        if c.value != f:
            log.append(f"{key}: {c.value!r} -> {f}")
            c.value = f; n += 1
        c.font = F_LINK if ("SRC_" in f or "!" in f) else F_CALC
        c.fill = PatternFill(fill_type=None)
    return n, log


# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5. F14: every "每 GW" output divided by Inputs!E5
def f14(wb):
    n = 0
    def wrap(ws, ref):
        nonlocal n
        v = ws[ref].value
        if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=") and not v.endswith("/CTL_GW"):
            ws[ref].value = "=(" + v[1:] + ")/CTL_GW"; n += 1
    itf = wb["Interface"]
    for r in (6, 7, 8, 9, 10, 11, 12, 13, 15):
        for c in range(3, 18): wrap(itf, f"{L(c)}{r}")
    wrap(wb["Checks"], "B4"); wrap(wb["Checks"], "B5")
    sen = wb["Sensitivity"]
    for c in range(3, 26):
        if sen.cell(7, c).value == "=Inputs!$E$5*1000": sen.cell(7, c).value = "=1000"; n += 1
    sen["A7"].value = "IT 電力（每 GW 基準；F14）"
    # v5.11 (G0-5 scan): scenario values written as formulas (=0.05 etc.) become plain inputs (value unchanged)
    for ref in ("X8", "Y8", "N37"):
        v = sen[ref].value
        if isinstance(v, str) and re.fullmatch(r"=-?\d+(\.\d+)?", v):
            sen[ref].value = float(v[1:]) if "." in v else int(v[1:]); sen[ref].font = F_IN; n += 1
    dc = wb["DC_Cost"]
    dc["A1"].value = "DC_Cost — 設施合計（IT 規模＝Inputs!E5 GW，基準 1）：資本支出與年持有成本；5 世代 × 3 成本情境。每 GW 值見 Interface（F14）"
    for r, t in [(12, "機架數（設施）"), (14, "GPU 數（設施）"), (17, "B. 資本支出（$B；設施）"), (33, "總資本支出（設施）"),
                 (37, "C. 年持有成本 — 會計口徑（$B／年；設施）"), (50, "D. 年持有成本 — 經濟口徑（資本回收年金；設施）")]:
        dc[f"A{r}"].value = t
    wb["Inputs"]["H5"].value = "口徑：IT 關鍵電力。v5.11 起 DC_Cost 為設施合計；Interface、L1 與模型頁的「每 GW」一律已除以本格（F14）"
    return n

GM_HDR = ["GM_ID", "範圍", "工作表", "格", "列標籤", "類別", "區間角色", "SRC_ID（來源或可比對象）", "關係", "決策 ID", "低", "高", "區間文字",
          "理由", "標記變更（v5.11）", "CC 敏感度分段",
          "模型值", "SRC 值", "SRC 狀態", "SRC 等級", "實際狀態（建置時）",
          "E1 原始寫死", "E2 Analogy 缺可比", "E3 缺區間", "E4 缺理由", "E5 Decision 缺 ID", "E6 決策 ID 不存在", "E9 SRC 非 Active",
          "E10 區間順序", "W2 3 級×高段", "E12 SRC 不存在", "SRC_Index 列（MATCH；v5.12）"]
GM_LAST = 700

# ---------------------------------------------------------------- 5a. SRC_Index (v5.12 A; builder-owned, rebuilt every build)
# Why: v5.11 Gov_Map S／T ran 16 MATCH per row over 4 SRC sheets × rows 5..400 (≈6,960 MATCH; full recalc 3.4–3.7 s),
# a cost that grows with Gov_Map rows × SRC sheets. SRC_Index stacks the A (ID), O (status) and K (grade) columns of every
# SRC sheet into one list, so Gov_Map needs one MATCH per row (column AF), shared by S and T.
# A sentinel block mirrors Gov_Map!H, so MATCH always finds the ID (an ID absent from every SRC sheet lands in the sentinel
# block, whose status／grade read "不存在", exactly the v5.11 result) — no #N/A, no new function (no IFERROR).
IDX_HEAD = 50                       # spare slots per SRC sheet after its last record (Checks E13 flags records beyond them)

def _span_end(src):
    """Last row covered for an SRC sheet: last record + IDX_HEAD, capped at SRC_LAST (shared by SRC_Index and the X columns)."""
    last = max([rr for rr in range(5, min(src.max_row, SRC_LAST) + 1) if src.cell(rr, 1).value not in (None, "")] or [4])
    return min(last + IDX_HEAD, SRC_LAST)

def src_index(wb):
    if "SRC_Index" in wb.sheetnames: del wb["SRC_Index"]
    ws = wb.create_sheet("SRC_Index")
    title(ws, "SRC_Index — SRC_* 的 ID、狀態、等級依序堆疊（builder 擁有，每次重建；只供 Gov_Map 查找，不放任何數值）",
          "Gov_Map AF 欄以 1 個 MATCH 找到 SRC_ID 所在列，S（狀態）、T（等級）欄以 INDEX 讀本頁。各 SRC 頁的範圍＝第 5 列到最後一筆紀錄＋"
          f"{IDX_HEAD} 列；紀錄超出範圍時 Checks E13 報錯（重建即可）。最後一段為 Gov_Map H 欄的鏡像（哨兵）：找不到的 SRC_ID 落在這段，狀態與等級為「不存在」。")
    for i, (h, w) in enumerate(zip(["SRC_ID", "工作表", "原列", "狀態", "等級"], [16, 14, 7, 12, 8])):
        put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}4", h, F_BOLD); ws.column_dimensions[L(i+1)].width = w
    r = 5; spans = {}; date_rows = {}; sentinel = []
    for sh in SRC_SHEETS:
        src = wb[sh]
        end = _span_end(src)
        spans[sh] = (r, end)
        for rr in range(5, end + 1):
            put(ws, f"A{r}", f'={sh}!$A{rr}&""'); put(ws, f"B{r}", sh); put(ws, f"C{r}", rr, F_CALC)
            put(ws, f"D{r}", f"={sh}!$O{rr}"); put(ws, f"E{r}", f"={sh}!$K{rr}")
            date_rows[r] = (sh, rr)
            r += 1
    sent0 = r
    for gr in range(5, GM_LAST + 1):
        put(ws, f"A{r}", f'=Gov_Map!$H{gr}&""'); put(ws, f"B{r}", "（哨兵）", F_NOTE); put(ws, f"C{r}", gr, F_CALC)
        put(ws, f"D{r}", "不存在"); put(ws, f"E{r}", "不存在")
        sentinel.append(r)
        r += 1
    v529.src_index_dates(wb, date_rows, sentinel)      # v5.29: F column (SRC 審查日) and IDX_SrcDate, read by Gov_Map AI and Load_Bearing
    _nm(wb, "IDX_SrcID", f"SRC_Index!$A$5:$A${r-1}")
    _nm(wb, "IDX_SrcStat", f"SRC_Index!$D$5:$D${r-1}")
    _nm(wb, "IDX_SrcGrade", f"SRC_Index!$E$5:$E${r-1}")
    ws.freeze_panes = "A5"
    return dict(rows=r - 5, src_rows=sent0 - 5, spans={k: v[1] for k, v in spans.items()})

# v5.12 (A): input cells created by moving formula constants out (交接第 8i 節的判定). Each entry: (sheet, column-A label of the
# row, column span, fields). The cell is located by its label, so the row number is never hard-coded here.
GOV_MAP_V512A = [
  ("Arch", "上下文長度（上一列顯示用）", "C", dict(scope="切片一", label="上下文長度（128K 上下文每序列 KV 顯示列）", cls="Assumed", role="單值",
      rtext="結構選擇（無數值區間）", reason="顯示列口徑 128,000 tok（非 131,072），無任何引用；v5.12 自 Arch C31:E31 公式移出（值不變）", seg="無")),
  ("Sens_Train", "情境倍數（×；黃底藍字＝作用中，乘在該情境改動的量上）", "O:R", dict(scope="切片二頁（v5.12 A 包）",
      label="情境倍數：RL rollout token × 0.3／× 3", cls="情境值", role="群組", reason="Sens_Train 情境；v5.12 自 O53:R53 公式移出（值不變）", seg="—")),
  ("Sens_Train", "情境倍數（×；黃底藍字＝作用中，乘在該情境改動的量上）", "Y:AB", dict(scope="切片二頁（v5.12 A 包）",
      label="情境倍數：合成資料 token × 0／× 3", cls="情境值", role="群組",
      reason="Sens_Train 情境；v5.12 自 AA93:AB93 公式與 Y93:Z93 直接寫入的 0 移出（值不變）", seg="—")),
  ("Sens_Rev", "ε（上一列量級情境的指數；能力 ∝ 有效算力^ε）", "B", dict(scope="切片二頁（v5.12 A 包）", label="ε（K4 (a) 量級情境）",
      cls="情境值", role="單值", reason="K4 (a) 若採用的量級情境；v5.12 自 D17、F17 公式移出（值不變）", seg="—")),
  ("Tech_Registry", "門檻", "J", dict(scope="切片二頁（v5.12 A 包）", label="主流判定門檻（公開採用實驗室數）", cls="Decision", role="單值",
      dec="J14", reason="J14：至少兩家實驗室公開採用即為主流；v5.12 自 K5:K16 公式移出（值不變）", seg="—")),
]

def _find_row(ws, label):
    for r in range(1, ws.max_row + 1):
        if ws.cell(r, 1).value == label: return r
    raise KeyError(f"{ws.title}: row label not found: {label}")

def gm_append(wb, ws):
    have = {(ws[f"C{r}"].value, ws[f"D{r}"].value) for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    have |= {("Har_In", "C12:G12"), ("Train_In", "C34:E34")}     # v10.1 4-1：GM481 縮為 C12:D12、GM540 停用後，原登錄範圍不得重新補登
    ids = [ws[f"A{r}"].value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if isinstance(ws[f"A{r}"].value, str) and ws[f"A{r}"].value.startswith("GM")]
    nxt = max(int(x[2:]) for x in ids) + 1 if ids else 1
    r = max([rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws[f"C{rr}"].value] or [4]) + 1
    added = 0
    for sh, lab, span, g in GOV_MAP_V512A:
        rr = _find_row(wb[sh], lab)
        c0, c1 = (span.split(":") + [span])[:2]
        cell = f"{c0}{rr}" if c0 == c1 else f"{c0}{rr}:{c1}{rr}"
        if (sh, cell) in have: continue
        vals = [f"GM{nxt:03d}", g["scope"], sh, cell, g["label"], g["cls"], g["role"], g.get("src") or DASH, g.get("rel") or DASH,
                g.get("dec") or DASH, None, None, g.get("rtext") or DASH, g["reason"], DASH, g.get("seg") or DASH]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals):
            put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}{r}", v, F_CALC, wrap=i in (4, 8, 13, 14))
        r += 1; nxt += 1; added += 1
    return added

def gm_append_c(wb, ws):
    """v5.13 C: register the slice-two pages' numeric blue cells (GOV_MAP_V513C) when the (sheet, cell) is not yet in Gov_Map.
    The row's column-A label must still match: a moved or renamed row stops the build instead of registering the wrong cell."""
    have = {(ws[f"C{r}"].value, ws[f"D{r}"].value) for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1)}
    have |= {("Har_In", "C12:G12"), ("Train_In", "C34:E34")}     # v10.1 4-1：GM481 縮為 C12:D12、GM540 停用後，原登錄範圍不得重新補登
    ids = [ws[f"A{r}"].value for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if isinstance(ws[f"A{r}"].value, str) and ws[f"A{r}"].value.startswith("GM")]
    nxt = max(int(x[2:]) for x in ids) + 1 if ids else 1
    r = max([rr for rr in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws[f"C{rr}"].value] or [4]) + 1
    added = 0
    for g in GOV_MAP_V513C + GOV_MAP_V515 + v519.GOV_MAP_V519 + v522.GOV_MAP_V522 + v523.GOV_MAP_V523 + v529.gov_map_rows(wb) + v531.gov_map_rows(wb) + v532.gov_map_rows(wb) + v533.gov_map_rows(wb) + v534.gov_map_rows(wb) + v535.gov_map_rows(wb) + v536.gov_map_rows(wb) + v601.gov_map_rows(wb) + v602.gov_map_rows(wb) + v700.gov_map_rows(wb) + v800.gov_map_rows(wb):
        if (g["sheet"], g["cell"]) in have: continue
        first = g["cell"].split(":")[0]
        row = int(re.sub(r"[A-Z]+", "", first))
        if wb[g["sheet"]].cell(row, 1).value != g.get("check", g["label"]):     # "check": 模型頁欄 A 的實際標籤（Gov_Map 顯示標籤可不同）
            raise KeyError(f"GOV_MAP_V513C: {g['sheet']}!{g['cell']} row label changed: {wb[g['sheet']].cell(row, 1).value!r} != {g.get('check', g['label'])!r}")
        vals = [f"GM{nxt:03d}", g["scope"], g["sheet"], g["cell"], g["label"], g["cls"], g["role"], g["src"] or DASH, g["rel"] or DASH,
                g["dec"] or DASH, g["lo"], g["hi"], g["rtext"] or DASH, g["reason"] or DASH, g["retag"] or DASH, g["seg"] or DASH]
        for i, v in enumerate(vals):
            font = F_IN if i in (10, 11) and isinstance(v, (int, float)) else (F_LINK if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=") else F_CALC)
            put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}{r}", v, font, wrap=i in (4, 8, 13, 14))
        r += 1; nxt += 1; added += 1
    return added


def gm_update(ws):
    """v5.13: judgment updates to existing Gov_Map rows (Excel-owned A–P). Each field is written only while it still holds the
    v5.12 value, so the update applies once and never overwrites a later Excel edit."""
    loc = {(ws[f"C{r}"].value, ws[f"D{r}"].value): r for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1) if ws[f"C{r}"].value}
    n = 0
    for sh, cell, fields in GOV_MAP_UPD + GOV_MAP_UPD_E:
        r = loc.get((sh, cell))
        if r is None: continue
        for col, (old, new) in fields.items():
            if ws[f"{col}{r}"].value == old:
                ws[f"{col}{r}"].value = new; n += 1
    return n


def gov_map(wb, src_index):
    ws = wb["Gov_Map"] if "Gov_Map" in wb.sheetnames else None
    if ws is None:
        ws = wb.create_sheet("Gov_Map")
        title(ws, "Gov_Map — 模型頁藍字格登錄（Stage 1 切片一：Inputs、Spec_Rack、Arch、Serving、Workload、Calib、Energy、NonNV 與其敏感度情境格）",
              "A–P 欄為判斷（Excel 擁有；類別、SRC_ID、決策 ID、區間、理由）；Q–AE 欄為 builder 每次重建的公式與建置時狀態。"
              "Checks G 節加總 V–AE 欄。區間角色＝低／高者為另一格的端點，不另檢查區間。")
        for i, h in enumerate(GM_HDR):
            put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}4", h, F_BOLD, wrap=True)
            ws.column_dimensions[L(i+1)].width = [8, 10, 11, 9, 26, 16, 7, 14, 22, 8, 9, 9, 18, 36, 22, 7][i] if i < 16 else 9
        for j, g in enumerate(GOV_MAP):
            r = 5 + j
            vals = [f"GM{j+1:03d}", g["scope"], g["sheet"], g["cell"], g["label"], g["cls"], g["role"], g["src"] or DASH, g["rel"] or DASH,
                    g["dec"] or DASH, g["lo"], g["hi"], g["rtext"] or DASH, g["reason"] or DASH, g["retag"] or DASH, g["seg"] or DASH]
            for i, v in enumerate(vals):
                font = F_IN if i in (10, 11) and isinstance(v, (int, float)) else (F_LINK if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=") else F_CALC)
                put(ws, f"{L(i+1)}{r}", v, font, wrap=i in (4, 8, 13, 14))
        ws.freeze_panes = "E5"
    if ws["AF4"].value is None: put(ws, "AF4", GM_HDR[31], F_BOLD, wrap=True)
    n_rp = v535.gov_map_repoint(wb, ws)      # v5.35 B5: GM629–GM633 (Cap_In H10 cells that moved one row down) re-pointed before the cell-keyed append (label guard; 0 on a v5.35-based rebuild)
    gm_append(wb, ws)
    n_c = gm_append_c(wb, ws)
    n_upd = gm_update(ws) + v518.gov_update(ws) + v519.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v520.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v521.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v525.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v527.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v529.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v531.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v532.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v533.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v534.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v536.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v601.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v603.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text) + v700.gov_update(ws, v518._append_text)      # v6.3: J1 r1 range text; v6.1: D3／D6／D10／D13／Q3 judgement columns; v5.36: GM596／597 pricing-multiple range text and reason (X46); v5.34: GM441／GM442 (B4_Disc) range text 0.1–0.4 and notes (J20); v5.33: GM594／GM590／GM586／GM587 notes, GM586 range text; v5.32: GM594 reason (append); v5.31: X16／X17 judgement updates (Inputs D30:F30, Spec_Rack E11:E13); v5.29: X14 notes, GM586 range text, GM453 note (r2: stays on 004) and 反轉門檻 column header; v5.27: X13 notes; v5.25: GM248 range, X12 notes; v5.18: judgement columns, P (B method), D5 ranges; v5.19: X2 P promotions
    # ---- builder-owned columns Q..AF
    n = 0; static_raw_hard = 0
    for r in range(5, ws.max_row + 1):
        sh, cell = ws[f"C{r}"].value, ws[f"D{r}"].value
        if not sh or not cell: continue
        n += 1
        single = ":" not in str(cell)
        h = f"$H{r}"
        put(ws, f"Q{r}", f"='{sh}'!{cell}" if single else DASH, F_LINK)
        sid = ws[f"H{r}"].value
        if isinstance(sid, str) and sid in src_index:
            s2, rr = src_index[sid]
            # value field: the one the model cell links to, else the record value, else its low end
            fm = _fm().get(f"{sh}!{cell}", "")
            m = re.search(re.escape(sid) + r"(_Lo|_Hi|_Spd|_ISL|_OSL|_MTP)?\b", fm)
            suf = m.group(1) if m and m.group(1) else ("" if wb[s2][f"C{rr}"].value is not None else "_Lo")
            put(ws, f"R{r}", f"={sid}{suf}", F_LINK)
        else:
            put(ws, f"R{r}", DASH)
        put(ws, f"AF{r}", f'=IF(OR({h}="{DASH}",{h}=""),"{DASH}",MATCH({h},IDX_SrcID,0))')
        put(ws, f"S{r}", f'=IF(ISNUMBER($AF{r}),INDEX(IDX_SrcStat,$AF{r}),"{DASH}")')
        put(ws, f"T{r}", f'=IF(ISNUMBER($AF{r}),INDEX(IDX_SrcGrade,$AF{r}),"{DASH}")')
        if single:
            v = wb[sh][cell].value
            st = ("連結 SRC" if "SRC_" in v else "公式") if isinstance(v, str) and v.startswith("=") else ("藍字（常數）" if v is not None else "空白")
        else:
            st = DASH
        put(ws, f"U{r}", st)
        F = f"$F{r}"; G = f"$G{r}"
        put(ws, f"V{r}", f'=IF(AND({F}="原始數據",$U{r}<>"連結 SRC"),1,0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"W{r}", f'=IF(AND({F}="Analogy",OR({h}="{DASH}",{h}="")),1,0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"X{r}", f'=IF(AND(OR({F}="Analogy",{F}="Assumed"),{G}<>"低",{G}<>"高",NOT(ISNUMBER($K{r})),NOT(ISNUMBER($L{r})),OR($M{r}="{DASH}",$M{r}="")),1,0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"Y{r}", f'=IF(AND(OR({F}="Analogy",{F}="Assumed",{F}="Derived（待改公式）",{F}="Derived（公式）"),OR($N{r}="{DASH}",$N{r}="",$N{r}=0)),1,0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"Z{r}", f'=IF(AND({F}="Decision",OR($J{r}="{DASH}",$J{r}="")),1,0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"AA{r}", f'=IF(OR($J{r}="{DASH}",$J{r}=""),0,IF(COUNTIF(Decisions!$A$5:$A$300,$J{r})=0,1,0))', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"AB{r}", f'=IF(AND({F}="原始數據",$S{r}<>"Active"),1,0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"AC{r}", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER($K{r}),ISNUMBER($L{r}),ISNUMBER($Q{r})),IF(OR($Q{r}<MIN($K{r},$L{r}),$Q{r}>MAX($K{r},$L{r})),1,0),0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"AD{r}", f'=IF(AND(ISNUMBER($T{r}),$P{r}="高"),IF($T{r}=3,1,0),0)', fmt="0")
        put(ws, f"AE{r}", f'=IF($S{r}="不存在",1,0)', fmt="0")      # v5.13: all scopes (slice-two SRC sheets exist)
        if st == "藍字（常數）" and ws[f"F{r}"].value == "原始數據": static_raw_hard += 1
    return n, static_raw_hard, n_upd + n_rp, n_c
```
